title: Amazon Catalog & Case Specialist / Troubleshooter – Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are a fast-growing Amazon brand based in Vienna, Austria. We sell on Amazon EU, US and AU. With every new product and SKU, the number of catalog issues grows. We are looking for a specialist who loves solving them and keeps our product detail pages in good shape.



Typical problems you’ll solve



Child ASINs breaking out of their parents

Reviews not syncing across variations

Size name and color name errors, and swatch images not showing

Lost Buy Box that needs to be fixed

Products under investigation or blocked because of a high NCX rate. You write and submit the appeal or Plan of Action (POA) and get the listings back online.



What you’ll do



Fix variation and parent-child issues, size and color name errors, and swatch images

Restore review sync and reactivate suppressed or broken listings

Find out why we lost the Buy Box and fix it

Handle NCX investigations and write appeals and POAs

Track and monitor the condition of all product detail pages, then prioritize the issues and solve them before they cost sales

Push content via flat files, in close collaboration with our Content & Catalog team

Open, escalate and follow up on Seller Support cases, and document your solutions as SOPs



What you bring



Years of experience as a catalog specialist or troubleshooter in Amazon seller accounts

A proven track record of solving catalog problems such as variations, attributes and suppressed listings

Strong Excel skills and confident use of flat files to push content

Experience writing successful appeals and POAs

Excellent English

A persistent, structured, detective mindset. You stay on a case until it is solved.



Nice to have



Agency experience

Experience with Amazon EU, US and AU

Brand Registry

Channable

German language skills

AI tools such as Claude Code or ChatGPT



Your first 90 days



Days 1–30: Learn our SKU and parent structure. Take stock of all open catalog issues and cases, and set up a case log.

Days 31–60: Clear the backlog of critical cases such as blocked ASINs and Buy Box issues. Document SOPs for recurring errors.

Days 61–90: Run ongoing monitoring of all detail pages, so issues are caught and fixed before sales are lost.



Engagement



Full-time (40 h/week), long-term, remote

You report to the Marketplace Team Lead and work closely with our Content & Catalog team



To apply: Start your proposal with the word “SWATCH”. Then describe one difficult catalog case you solved, for example a broken variation family or a blocked ASIN: what the problem was, what you did and how long it took.



Skills: Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Listing, Flat Files, Catalog Management, Amazon Account Health, Plan of Action, Amazon Brand Registry, Microsoft Excel, Troubleshooting



Screening questions:



A child ASIN has broken out of its parent and lost its reviews. What are your steps to fix it?

Have you written a POA for an NCX or product-quality block? What was the outcome?

How do you keep track of many open Seller Support cases at once?

Handle tickets in eDesk from Amazon, bol.com, Otto, Shopify and future marketplaces, and prioritize them

Answer customer inquiries mainly by
, and by phone when needed

Spot recurring issues with products, listings or deliveries, document them and report them to the team

Several years of experience in customer support, ideally in e-commerce or on marketplaces such as Amazon, bol.com, Otto or Shopify

Confident, hands-on use of eDesk (a must)

Excellent written and spoken English

Experience with both
 and phone support

Nice to have



German language skills

Experience with Amazon Buyer-Seller Messaging and A-to-Z claims

Other European languages, e.g. Dutch for bol.com

Using AI tools to draft replies

Days 31–60: Handle tickets independently across all channels, with response times consistently within marketplace requirements.

Days 61–90: Take on a full ticket load. Report recurring issues to the team and expand the reply templates.



Engagement



Full-time (40 h/week), long-term, remote

title: Freelance Performance Video Editor for E-Commerce Cartoon & VSLs
description:
HIRING: 1 PERFORMANCE & AI VIDEO EDITOR. DIRECT-RESPONSE ADS ONLY. 🎬



Read this before you DM me.



❌ DON'T DM ME IF

– you come with unrealistic prices.

– you're just here to pitch your editing services.

– your portfolio is wedding films, YouTube edits, reels or corporate videos. I don't want to see them.

– you've never edited paid Meta or TikTok ads for a DTC e-commerce brand.

– you don't work with AI video tools every week (Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, Suno or similar).



I only want to see direct-response Meta ads. And proof that they already printed: the spend and results behind them.



Still here? Good. 👇



We're building an upcoming 7–8 figure DTC e-commerce brand in DACH, with a US supplement brand next. We need an editor who makes ads that sell, not videos that just look nice.



🎯 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

– You turn a script into a finished ad without hand-holding. Nobody has to explain to you why the hook matters.

– You can explain why every hook, cut and B-roll you chose should work.

– Your pacing is tight: cuts on the rhythm of speech, a hook that stops the scroll in 1–3 seconds.

– You're reliable. A deadline is a deadline.

– You want to stay long-term and build this with us.

– Big plus: German (native or fluent). Our ads are in German.



📋 WHAT YOU'LL DO

– Edit direct-response ads from our scripts: VSLs, UGC, Yap ads, AI-animated ads

– Build hook variations for testing

– Create AI scenes, voiceovers and music when the script calls for it

– Deliver fast, with a short Loom on your choices when asked



💰 WHAT YOU GET

– €1.5K+ fixed monthly base + bonus on every winner you edited

– Direct work with the founder: no agency, no ticket queue

– All software paid by us

– A clear path to lead the editing team as we grow

– Fully remote, long-term



🔄 HOW TO APPLY

1. DM me a fresh 1–3 min Loom. Show your 3 best direct-response ads and the spend and results behind them (screenshot or dashboard). No proof, no reply.

2. Short call

3. Paid test video from a real script, which you walk us through on a call

4. Contract



One last thing: we care about details. Put the word "Brezel" in your DM. No "Brezel", no reply.

title: 3D Visualiser – Photorealistic Renders from SketchUp – Australian Residential – PHP 70–90k/month
description:
Builder of custom and architectural homes, knockdown-rebuilds and commercial projects in Melbourne. We need a 3D visualiser whose renders look like photos of the finished home, good enough that a client signs off on finishes from them.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

A client should not be able to tell your render from a photo. Correct scale, real materials (stone, timber, tile, render, cladding), accurate lighting for the time of day, believable furniture and landscaping, and camera angles a real photographer would use. Interiors and exteriors, day and dusk.



SKETCHUP – REQUIRED

Our models come to you in SketchUp (some from ArchiCAD via export). You must work confidently from SketchUp files every day. If you can't render from SketchUp, please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take SketchUp models and produce photorealistic interior and exterior renders

- Apply real product finishes from our selections (colours, tiles, benchtops, cladding, fixtures)

- Produce render sets for client presentations, marketing and our website

- Produce walkthrough or flythrough videos where a job needs it

- Clean up and fix imported models so they render correctly

- Turn revisions around quickly from our designer's markups

- Work with our designer and project team



TOOLS

- Essential: SketchUp plus at least one of V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion, D5 Render or Twinmotion

- Nice to have: ArchiCAD, Photoshop post-production, 3ds Max / Corona, Unreal Engine



ABOUT YOU

- A portfolio of your MOST REALISTIC work on real residential projects, interiors and exteriors

- You understand light, materials and composition, not just software settings

- Fast AND accurate. We will ask how long each render took, and we will check.

- Clear written English; you take review comments well and turn them around quickly

- A machine that handles heavy scenes (32 GB RAM, strong dedicated graphics card, SSD) and stable, fast internet



HOURS AND PAY

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, overlapping Victorian business hours (Victoria is 2–3 hours ahead of Manila)

- PHP 70,000–90,000 per month, set by the realism and speed of your work

- 4-week paid trial, then a long-term role with a growing builder



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs. Applications missing any item below will not be assessed.



Subject line, exactly:  RENDER-SKP – [Your Full Name]



Include:

1. Your CV

2. A portfolio link showing your 5 MOST REALISTIC renders (interior and exterior) from real projects

3. For two of those renders, the SketchUp model screenshot next to the final render, as Google Drive links

4. Which render engine you used for each, and how many hours each took from model to final image

5. What work or clients are you committed to now, and what notice would you need? What are your PC specs (graphics card) and internet speed?



We read every application that follows the brief, and we will invite shortlisted applicants to a short paid test render.

title: LinkedIn Outreach & Appointment Setter
description:
J. Siggers is a bespoke tailoring house run by its founder, James, between Dubai and London. Every garment is handmade in Italy. Our clients are CEOs, private bankers, law and consulting partners and founders across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK and Switzerland. They do not respond to hard selling. They respond to warmth, discretion and a tailor who knows more than they do.



The job

You will run James's own LinkedIn account, writing as James and book qualified appointments into his calendar. That is the whole job.

Most of your prospects are one step away. James is connected to most of his clients and their connections are your warm list. You find the right people, research them, write a personal message, handle the reply and book the call.



What you will do

• Build lists from James's network and Sales Navigator: senior people in Dubai, Riyadh, London and Geneva

• Research every person before contact. No specific reason to message means no message

• Write personalised connection requests and follow-ups in James's voice. No templates, no automation tools, no AI-pasted messages

• Reply to every inbound message within one working day

• Qualify, book, confirm, and brief James before each call

• Log everything in Zoho CRM and send a one-page report every Friday



Targets from month two: 15–20 researched connection requests a day and 8–12 qualified appointments a month. Quality beats volume. One call with a managing partner is worth more than twenty connections with people who will never buy.



You

• 2+ years of LinkedIn outreach or appointment setting, with numbers you can explain: acceptance rate, reply rate, calls booked

• Native-level written English with a natural, understated British register. If you write "I hope this message finds you well", this is not the role for you

• You have sold, or set appointments for, something expensive, where tone and timing mattered more than volume

• Fluent in Sales Navigator and comfortable in a CRM (we use Zoho)

• Organised, reliable and honest. You will be working under James's name. One automation tool or shortcut that puts the account at risk ends the arrangement

• At least 4 hours a day overlapping Dubai time (GMT+4), Monday to Friday

Nice to have: a real interest in menswear or luxury, experience reaching the Gulf market, cold
 tools (Instantly, Lemlist or similar).

Pay

• Full-time, 40 hours a week, fully remote

• USD 1,100–1,300 a month base depending on experience, paid monthly via Wise

• Plus USD 40 for every appointment James holds and USD 150 for every new client. Uncapped

• 13th-month pay, Philippine holidays, all tools provided

• 90-day trial, then a long-term role. James wants someone who is still here in three years

How to apply

Start your application with the word BEMBERG. Applications without it are deleted unread. Then send:

1. Three to five sentences on who you are, your outreach experience and your numbers

2. Your LinkedIn profile link

3. Written as James: a connection request (under 300 characters) and a first message (under 80 words) to a Dubai law firm partner who has just been promoted to head the Middle East practice. No "hope you're well"

4. Your available hours in Philippine time

Shortlisted candidates get a 20-minute call with James and a short paid trial task.

title: AI Video Assistant – Nano Banana Pro + Veo 3 + CapCut
description:
I Video Assistant – Replicate Short-Form Videos (Nano Banana Pro + Veo 3 + CapCut)



We produce short-form video content for e-commerce using AI tools. We're looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to replicate videos with new characters and backgrounds.



This is an easy, repetitive task. We provide a complete step-by-step workflow, ready-made prompts and reference images for every video. You just follow the system. No creative decisions required, no guesswork.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Generate character images in Nano Banana Pro (swap avatar + background while keeping the original framing and action)

- Animate the images in Veo 3 using the provided prompts

- Review each clip for quality (natural movement, correct lip sync, no cut-off audio, no text or logos) and regenerate when needed

- Edit and assemble the final video in CapCut (cuts, subtitles, export in 9:16)

- Upload the finished video to Google Drive and update the tracking sheet



Each video takes about 35 minutes. Target: 4–6 videos per shift once trained.



Note: videos are in Spanish. You do NOT need to speak Spanish, but you must check that the voice matches the lip movements and is not cut off.



TOOLS

We provide access to all paid tools (Nano Banana Pro, Veo 3, CapCut Pro). You only need a computer and a reliable internet connection.



REQUIREMENTS

- Basic experience with CapCut (or similar video editing tools)

- Strong attention to detail and comfort following step-by-step instructions

- Reliable internet connection and a computer that can run CapCut smoothly

- Available for a fixed schedule of 20 hours/week (Mon–Fri, 4 hours/day, [HOURS] PHT)

- Good written English for daily communication



COMPENSATION

- $[AMOUNT]/month (20 hours/week), paid [weekly/biweekly] via [Wise/PayPal]

- Paid test task before hiring

- Long-term position with room for more hours and a raise based on performance



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "AI VIDEO VA – [Your Name]" (applications without it will not be reviewed) and answer:

1. Have you used CapCut or another video editor before? For how long?

2. Do you have experience with AI image/video tools (Nano Banana Pro, Veo 3, Midjourney, etc.)? If not, are you comfortable learning a fixed workflow?

3. Confirm you can commit to 20 hours/week on the schedule above.

4. Share a sample of any video editing work (link to Drive, YouTube or TikTok).



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid test task: replicate one short clip using our workflow.

title: Social Med
description:
About the Role



I am looking for a reliable, creative and detail-oriented short-form video editor to support my content creation business. I work with a range of fashion, lifestyle and family-focused creators, producing Instagram Reels and other short-form social media content.



I am looking for someone who can take raw footage and turn it into engaging, well-paced videos that reflect each individual client's personality, style and sense of humour.



The editing itself is relatively simple. I do not need complex effects, transitions, filters or highly stylised edits. I need someone who understands short-form content, has a good eye for selecting the best clips, and can create clean, natural and engaging videos that feel authentic to each creator.



Key Responsibilities



Edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels and similar social media platforms.



Review raw footage and select the strongest, most relevant clips.



Cut and arrange footage to create a natural flow and engaging pace.



Add clear, accurate on-screen captions and text overlays.



Trim unnecessary pauses, mistakes and unwanted sections.



Follow reference videos and editing styles that I provide.



Adapt editing to suit different clients, including their individual personalities, tone of voice and sense of humour.



Understand comedic timing and recognise funny, relatable or engaging moments within footage.



Keep edits clean, simple and consistent with each client's established style.



Make revisions based on feedback and follow editing instructions carefully.



Keep project files and exported videos organised by client and project.



Editing Style and Software



I primarily use CapCut and Instagram Edits, so experience with either platform is preferred. Experience with other suitable editing software is welcome, provided you can deliver the same simple, clean editing style.



The editing will mainly involve:



Cutting and clipping footage.



Arranging clips into a clear, engaging sequence.



Adding captions and simple text overlays.



Basic pacing and timing adjustments.



Selecting the best takes and removing unnecessary footage.



Exporting finished videos in the correct vertical format.



I do not require complex motion graphics, elaborate transitions, heavy filters, colour grading or special effects. The focus is on good clip selection, timing, captions and understanding the content.



Understanding Different Clients



I work with approximately seven to eight clients, each with their own personality and content style. These include fashion, lifestyle and family-focused creators.



It is important that you can adapt your editing to different people rather than applying exactly the same style to every video.



For example:



Fashion content may need a clean, stylish and well-paced edit.



Lifestyle content may feel more conversational and natural.



Family and mum-life content may require an understanding of relatable humour and funny moments.



Some videos may need quicker cuts and stronger comedic timing, while others need a more relaxed feel.



I will provide examples, references, instructions and feedback for each client. You should be comfortable learning these styles and applying feedback consistently.



Workload



The role will involve approximately 56–64 short-form videos per month, based on seven to eight clients receiving up to eight videos each per month.



This is ongoing, recurring work rather than a one-off project. Work will be supplied throughout the month, with deadlines agreed in advance.



I am looking for someone who can manage their workload reliably, communicate clearly and deliver edits on time.



Ideal Candidate



You should:



Have experience editing short-form videos for social media.



Understand the pacing and structure of Instagram Reels and similar content.



Be confident adding accurate, well-timed captions.



Have a good eye for selecting strong clips from raw footage.



Understand humour, timing and personality-led content.



Be able to follow references while also using your own judgement.



Be organised, reliable and responsive to feedback.



Be comfortable working with several clients and keeping their styles separate.



Communicate clearly and flag any questions or issues early.



Be open to an ongoing working relationship.

Progress to utility takeoffs involving water, sewer, and storm systems.

Develop proficiency in 3D takeoffs and earthwork calculations as experience and training progress.

Organize takeoff results, calculations, and supporting documentation for the estimating team.



Plan Review & Quality Control:

Interpret construction drawings and identify relevant dimensions, quantities, and scope requirements.

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and conflicting details that could affect takeoff accuracy.

Double-check calculations and completed takeoffs before submission.

Ask questions when project information is unclear rather than making assumptions.

Incorporate feedback to improve accuracy and consistency.



Estimating Support & Documentation:

Maintain organized takeoff files and project documentation.

Communicate progress, outstanding questions, and potential issues proactively.

Prepare takeoff information in a clear format for senior estimators to review.

Follow established estimating procedures and meet agreed deadlines.

Help the team evaluate more bid opportunities by delivering reliable and accurate takeoffs.



Team Collaboration:

Work closely with the estimating team and participate in training and knowledge-sharing.

Communicate through Zoom,
, and messaging platforms.

Follow established workflows, templates, and quality standards.

Take ownership of assigned work while remaining receptive to guidance and feedback.



Qualifications



Experience in civil construction estimating, quantity takeoffs, or a related construction role.

Ability to read and interpret construction plans and specifications.

Experience performing accurate construction quantity takeoffs.

Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and communicate questions proactively.

Willingness to learn new software, follow established workflows, and incorporate feedback.



Software Requirements



AGTEK: Highly preferred.

Comparable software: Experience with Trimble Business Center, Bluebeam Revu, or similar construction takeoff software is an advantage.

Familiarity with CAD files and drawing layers is helpful; CAD design experience is not required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and general digital documentation tools is beneficial.



Relevant takeoff experience and the ability to interpret construction plans are the primary considerations. Candidates without AGTEK experience may be considered if they have relevant experience with comparable software and demonstrate the ability to learn AGTEK.



Work Setup

Employment Type: Full-Time, up to 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

Initial Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours to support training and collaboration

Long-Term Schedule Goal: Transition toward Philippine daytime hours, with some overlap with the U.S. team, so completed takeoffs are ready for review each morning

, and messaging platforms



How to Apply

2. Portfolio or Work Samples - showing relevant takeoff experience, if available and permitted to share. Please remove confidential client and project information.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor for an Animated Kids' Story Channel (YouTube)
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT

I'm launching a YouTube channel of animated folktales from around the world for children aged 3 to 7. Each episode is about 7 minutes. A recurring family of characters (a grandmother and her two grandchildren) introduces each story in soft 3D animation, and the story itself plays out in a 2D storybook style.



I write the scripts, shot lists and AI prompts. I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented creator to turn them into finished episodes using AI tools.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Animate shots with AI video tools (Kling 3.0, Google Veo), retrying until the characters match their references

- Generate character voice lines (ElevenLabs) and lip-sync them to the talking shots

- Assemble each episode in CapCut or DaVinci Resolve with voices, music, sound effects, captions and title cards

- Keep files organized in Google Drive and fill in a simple shot log (model used, tries, credits)

- Flag anything that looks off, such as glitches, extra limbs or characters drifting from their designs

- Hands-on experience with at least one AI video tool (Kling, Veo, Runway, Seedance or similar). Please share examples.

- Video editing experience in CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro

- A sharp eye for detail and consistency

- Clear written English and reliable communication: you meet deadlines, or tell me early when you can't

- A stable internet connection and a computer that runs a video editor smoothly

- Comfortable making gentle, wholesome content for young children



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience keeping characters consistent across AI shots (reference images, character elements)

- Experience with animation or children's content

- Experience with ElevenLabs, Suno or lip-sync tools



DETAILS

- Part-time, 10–15 hours a week, asynchronous 

- We'll start with a short paid test task of about 3 hours. Ongoing work for the right person, with more hours as the channel grows.

- All work is confidential, and everything you create for the channel belongs to the channel.

Start your application with the word "INKY" so I know you read this post. Then include:

Applications without samples won't be reviewed.

Hi everyone, we’re looking for someone who REALLY knows sports to evaluate our athletes and get them in front of the right college coaches.



THE COMPANY

Athlete Zero helps high school athletes earn scholarships at US universities. We need someone who can tell exactly what level each athlete can play at and who wants to communicate with coaches to place our athletes on their teams.



THE ROLE

- Athlete Evaluator & Coach Outreach, full time and 100% remote

- You’ll work directly with the families and help them d
 which offer is best for them



WHAT WE OFFER

- $400 - $600/month

- Real growth: if you prove yourself, there’s A LOT of room to grow inside the company

- The chance to directly change the lives of young athletes



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Ability to evaluate at least 3 of these sports: baseball, American football, soccer, basketball (volleyball and hockey are a plus)

- Solid knowledge of how college sports work in the US: NCAA/NAIA/JUCO divisions, recruiting calendars and contact rules, scholarships and roster sizes

- You can watch film and explain clearly what makes a player good, what’s missing, and which programs fit them

- Strong persuasive writing: you know how to get a coach’s attention in a few lines

- HIGH ability to speak, write and understand English

- Long-term commitment (several years)

- AGE DOESN’T MATTER

- You can’t evaluate at least 3 of the sports listed above

description:

We run an educational YouTube channel and training community that helps freelancers build sustainable remote careers. We are looking for a reliable, organized YouTube Production Coordinator & Video Editor to join our team part-time (20 hours/week). In this role, you will take ownership of our post-production pipeline—helping us turn long-form talking-head videos into engaging short-form clips and keeping our content calendar running smoothly.



Role & Responsibilities:

- Short-Form Video Editing: Watch our 18-to-20-minute weekly YouTube videos and pull 3 to 5 strong, standalone moments to turn into vertical shorts (60 seconds or under).

- You have prior experience editing talking-head, podcast, or educational YouTube content.

- You have a good ear for pacing—you know how to cut dead air, stumbles, and filler words so the speaker sounds natural and sharp.

- You are organized, hit your deadlines without needing reminders, and communicate early if you ever run into a roadblock.

title: Reels Clipper / Short-Form Video Editor – Contractor Brands – $5/hr + Performance Bonus
description:
About us

KickStar Marketing films live streams on construction job sites for roofers, remodelers and other contractors. We turn each stream into 25+ Instagram Reels that bring our clients real customer leads. We’re growing fast and want a long-term clipper who wants to grow with us.



What you’ll do



Take 1–2 hour live stream recordings and cut them into vertical Reels (15–45 seconds)

Use an AI clipping tool for the first pass, then pick the best moments by hand

Write a strong hook for the first second of every clip

Add accurate burned-in captions, a 9:16 crop, the client’s logo, and a call to action at the end

Make 2–3 hook versions of the best clips so we can test which one wins

Log your hours and clips in our shared Clip Desk, and follow our checklist on every stream



You’re a fit if you



Have 1+ year editing short-form content (Reels, TikTok or Shorts)

Are fast in CapCut or edits app

Have used AI clipping tool

Write clean English captions with no typos

Have reliable internet and can deliver within 48 hours

Are available at least 4 hours overlapping 8am–12pm Pacific Time



Pay



$5/hour to start, paid weekly

Bonus for every clip that passes our view target

Raise after 60 days based on output and performance

Full-time role for the right person as we add clients



How to apply



Send links to your 3 best Reels or TikToks (not a full portfolio)

Tell us in one sentence what makes a good hook

Start your application with the word “JOBSITE” so we know you read this



Shortlisted applicants do one paid test: 3 clips from a sample stream.

Social media and content

We are looking for someone who can research and find strong creators and communities for potential plush collaborations.





========================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

========================================



Your job is to find creators, brands, games, and online communities that could realistically become successful plush products.



This is NOT just about finding large creators.



We are specifically looking for creators with:



- Recognizable mascots, avatars, characters, creatures, memes, or other visual identities

- Strong and active communities

- Clear potential for a plush product

- Enough audience and buying potential for a successful product



The most important question is:



“Would fans realistically buy this as a plush product?”





========================================

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

========================================



A good lead MUST meet these requirements:



1. The creator must be ACTIVE

No dead channels, abandoned accounts, or creators with long upload breaks.



2. The creator/community must have enough buying potential

The audience should be large and engaged enough that selling 200+ plush units is realistically possible.



3. The creator should NOT already sell plush merchandise

We are specifically looking for creators who currently do not already sell plush products.



4. There must be a strong plush concept

The creator must have at least one of the following:

- Mascot

- Avatar

- Inside joke

- Character

- Meme

- Creature

- Recognizable visual identity



And it must be something that could realistically be turned into a strong and appealing plush product.



We are NOT looking for:

- Generic influencers with no recognizable visual identity

- Inactive creators

- Tiny communities with no buying potential

- Random gaming creators with no mascot/character potential





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================



- Research creators, brands, games, and communities

- Find strong plush collaboration opportunities

-Identifying the specific mascot, character, avatar, meme, creature, or visual identity that could become a plush

- Evaluating whether the community has realistic potential to buy the product

- Collect contact details/socials

- Organizing your research and findings clearly





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



- Good internet research skills

- Understanding of online communities and creator culture

- An understanding of YouTube, gaming, and content creators

- Attention to detail

- Good English communication skills

-The ability to recognize opportunities beyond simple follower counts





========================================

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

- Flexible schedule





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. Short introduction

2. Relevant experience

3. Contact information 
 etc.)



IMPORTANT:

Please include 3 SAMPLE LEADS you personally researched.



For EACH sample lead include:



- Who they are

- Links/socials media

- WHAT specifically could become the plush

- WHY fans would likely buy it

- WHY the community is a strong fit



Weak answers:

“Big creator”, “gaming audience”, “popular community”



Strong answers:

Specific mascot/avatar/character ideas with clear collectible and fandom appeal.

Apply with your CV, LinkedIn profile, relevant portfolio and answers to every question below. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a paid 90-minute practical exercise. We are looking for specific evidence of what you have done. Client details may be anonymised.



Application questions



Please answer all ten questions in order. Applications with missing answers will not be reviewed. A CV or portfolio alone is incomplete. If you have no experience in an area, say so. Keep answers concise and link to supporting examples.



1. Is A$1,500 per month acceptable for the proposed 40-hour week? State your current location, time zone, Sydney overlap, notice period and earliest start date. If applying on a fractional basis, state the hours you can commit at that budget.



2. List your two longest relevant employer or client relationships, with start and end month/year, role and whether each was employment or a freelance retainer. What did you personally own?



3. Describe one creator programme you managed. Over what period, how many creators did you approach, sign, activate and retain, and how many usable assets were delivered? State which parts you owned.



4. Share two examples of creator content you briefed or managed. Explain the hook, audience, product demonstration, objection handled and call to action. Include conversion results you can substantiate.



5. How would you find creators who already talk publicly about caring for an older parent or grandparent and could use MINA with their family?



a) Name the first two platforms or public communities you would search. Give 3–5 exact search phrases or hashtags and explain how you would narrow the results by country, language or care context.



b) Explain the steps from finding a relevant post to locating the creator’s profile and published business-contact or DM route.



c) How would you check family-care relevance, content quality, genuine household interest and responsiveness? Explain what you can assess before contact and what you would confirm through replies and follow-through.



Keep your answer to about 150 words. Use previous work where helpful.



6. Share an anonymised example of an outreach message you previously wrote for a creator campaign. Describe a past fee negotiation: what the creator requested, how you responded and the outcome. Use existing work; no new MINA outreach copy is required.



7. Which MMPs and analytics products have you actually used, including AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch or GA4? For each, explain what you did and describe one campaign or event report you worked with.



8. How would you measure the path from a creator link to install, trial where offered, paid subscription and retained use? What could attribution miss? How would you exclude gifted creator households from paid acquisition results?



9. Show an anonymised tracker or describe the fields and weekly routine you would use to manage 50 creators, onboarding, usage, briefs, rights, deadlines and follow-ups.



10. Tell us about a creator campaign that underperformed or missed a deadline. What did the data or conversations reveal, what did you change and what happened next?

title: Expert Cold Caller & Appointment Setter - US Healthcare (Part Time)
description:

We are looking for a mastery-level cold caller and appointment setter to help us build referral partnerships with doctors' offices and healthcare organizations across the United States.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Educate offices on how Total Life supports their patients and on Medicare programs such as the CMS ACCESS Model. This is an education-first, consultative approach, not a hard sell

- Book qualified meetings between prospects and our partnerships team

- Follow up on warm leads from
 campaigns and conferences

- Log every call, outcome and next step accurately 

- Share weekly results and feedback on which scripts and objections are working



REQUIRED

- 3+ years of proven cold calling and appointment setting experience with US clients (B2B preferred)

- Track record of hitting call and booked-meeting targets (please share your numbers)

- Experience with a CRM (HubSpot strongly preferred) and dialer tools

PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience calling into US healthcare: doctors' offices, clinics, home health, senior living or Medicare-related programs

SCHEDULE

Part time, about 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday during US business hours. Strong performers may be offered more hours.



HOW TO APPLY

- Start your application with the words "Total Life Caller" so we know you read this post

Experience creating or managing Airbnb, 
 or VRBO listings

Organised, reliable and happy working from checklists and SOPs

Your own computer, tech savvy, a fast internet connection and a backup if power or internet goes down

Nice to have: experience with Guesty or another property management system, PriceLabs, channel managers or Xero, or previous work as an Airbnb or short-term rental VA.

Based on 20 hours per week at $4/hour. Covers your core weekly work: launching and listing properties, keeping listings accurate and supporting our Onboarding Manager.

Bonuses (uncapped)

Each property you launch within 5 working days of handover that passes our final quality check with no critical errors

$25

$100

How it works

Why join us

title: Customer Retention Specialist (Part-Time, US Customers)
description:
Type of work: Part-time

Hours: 20 hours a week, 4 hours a day, 5 days a week

Schedule: Wednesday to Sunday, 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM US Eastern (Thursday to Monday, 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine time)

Salary: TBD



About us



Redwood Remedies is a US telehealth company offering prescription men’s health treatment by subscription. Our customers are mostly men in their 50s and 60s across the US, and many of them call us with a question before their next refill. We’re looking for someone who enjoys those conversations and can keep a customer with us when a well-timed call makes the difference.



What you’ll do



You’ll own our retention calls each shift. Most of your time goes to calling customers a few days before their subscription renews to check how the treatment is going, answer questions and help them pick the plan that suits them. When a customer asks to cancel or pause, you’ll call to understand why and walk them through the options we can offer, such as a different product, a pause or a one-time order. You’ll also contact customers whose payment didn’t go through and help them update their card.



You’ll record every outcome during the call: updating the subscription in our admin panel and payment system, and logging the call in our CRM (GoHighLevel). When one of our two support agents is out, you’ll pick up extra hours to cover support, which includes inbound calls, texts and
.



What we’re looking for



At least 1 year in retention, save desk, account management or subscription customer service for US customers, ideally by phone

Clear, natural spoken English and comfort speaking with older American customers about a sensitive health topic

Comfort handling objections and making an offer, while respecting a customer’s decision when they want to leave

Careful notes. Every call gets logged accurately, the same day. To show us you read closely, put the word SEQUOIA in the subject line of your application.

Experience with a CRM. GoHighLevel, HubSpot or similar is a plus

Available 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Thursday to Monday, including US weekends

Flexibility to add hours on short notice when a teammate is out

A quiet workspace, a reliable computer, a noise-cancelling headset and a stable internet connection with a backup



What we offer



Compensation package: TBD

Fully remote, with a small team that works together on Slack

Training on our products, systems and offers before you take your first call



How to apply



Please send:



Your resume

A short note about a time you kept a customer who wanted to cancel: what they said, what you offered, and how it ended

A link to a 5-minute video introduction, candid and unscripted. Tell us about yourself, your experience with customers, and why this role interests you. Speak naturally; we’d rather see how you really talk than a polished script.



Applications missing any of the items above won’t be reviewed.

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Support (GoHighLevel)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly disciplined, meticulous, and proactive Executive Assistant & Operations Support Specialist to work directly under the company founder. This is NOT an entry-level data entry role. We operate a fast-paced B2B agency environment where precision, strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and zero-inbox discipline are mandatory. If you require constant micromanagement, miss deadlines, or struggle with technical software, please do not apply.



Core Role & Daily Responsibilities:

1. Executive & Administrative Management:

- Maintain strict gatekeeping of the founder's executive inbox; categorize, triage, and draft responses to client and vendor correspondence within designated SLA windows.

- Manage complex calendar scheduling across multiple time zones (US Eastern Time alignment required), resolving conflicts proactively and preparing pre-call briefing documents 24 hours prior to every meeting.

- Transcribe meeting action items, assign tasks to relevant team members, and relentlessly follow up until completion is verified.



2. GoHighLevel (GHL) & CRM Operations:

- Build, audit, and maintain sub-account pipelines, automated workflows, triggers, and contact tags inside GoHighLevel.

- Conduct daily CRM hygiene audits to ensure zero duplicate records, accurate opportunity stage tracking, and proper webhook/form attributions.

- Troubleshoot basic workflow errors, calendar integration issues, and notification routing inside GoHighLevel without waiting to be asked.



3. Documentation, SOPs & Project Coordination:

- Track weekly team KPIs, deliverables, and project milestones inside our project management workspace.

- Turn recurring operational fixes into structured, step-by-step written and video SOPs so the company knowledge base remains current at all times.

- Submit a structured End-of-Day (EOD) report every single shift detailing completed tasks, metrics, and any operational bottlenecks.



Strict Minimum Requirements:

- Minimum 2+ years of verifiable experience as a C-level Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or GHL Admin.

- Demonstrable hands-on proficiency inside GoHighLevel (you will be asked about this).

- Near-native written and spoken English communication skills with impeccable grammar.

- Primary workstation with minimum 50 Mbps fiber internet, plus a verified backup power and backup internet source (zero unexcused downtime during core hours).

- Availability to work 20-40 hours per week aligned with US business hours.



How to Apply:

Attention to detail is our highest priority. Generic, copy-pasted, or AI-generated templates will be rejected immediately without review. Follow these exact instructions:

1. Use the exact subject line: EA - Your Full Name

2. Start your application message with the word SUNRISE on the very first line, alone, before writing anything else.

3. In a numbered section of 2 to 3 sentences, tell us about your specific experience using GoHighLevel (what you actually built or managed).

4. Include a link to your resume (Google Drive link set to "Anyone with the link") and a brief video introduction walking us through why you fit this role.

5. State your expected monthly salary for a full-time role as the very last line of your message.



Salary: $1500 - $1,800/month depending on experience

About Boarding & Beyond:

Founded in 1996, Boarding & Beyond has spent 30 years making a difference in the lives of dogs and the families who love them. Located in Aurora, Colorado, USA, we provide dog daycare, boarding, and grooming services.  Our mission is simple: Change dogs' lives for the better while giving pet parents peace of mind. 



We believe exceptional businesses are built by exceptional people. Our culture values customer service, ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.  We're looking for a highly capable professional who wants to make a meaningful contribution to our continued growth.



Your Mission: Generate More Paying Customers



Your primary responsibility will be to help Boarding & Beyond acquire new customers, convert more inquiries into bookings, and increase repeat business.



We already receive inquiries from dog owners interested in our services. Your first priority will be making sure those opportunities turn into paying customers.



Beyond sales conversion, you'll take ownership of customer follow-up, CRM execution, referral generation, local business outreach, and organic marketing initiatives.



You'll be responsible for executing proven strategies, identifying improvements, and producing measurable results.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Sales & Lead Conversion — Your #1 Priority



- Personally call, text, and
 prospective customers to convert inquiries into bookings.

- Proactively follow up with leads who haven't booked.

- Build rapport, establish trust, handle objections, and close sales.

- Identify missed sales opportunities and recover potential customers.

- Improve sales scripts, follow-up strategies, and booking conversion rates.

- Track leads, sales activity, and conversion performance.

- Take ownership of ensuring qualified opportunities don't get overlooked.



We're looking for someone who is already confident, persuasive, and effective at selling over the phone.



2. CRM Management & Sales Optimization



You'll use GoHighLevel to manage leads, customer communication, follow-up, and sales opportunities.



- Keep CRM records organized, accurate, and actionable.

- Manage sales pipelines and ensure timely follow-up.

- Review recorded customer calls to identify missed sales opportunities and customer service issues.

- Recommend and implement improvements that increase conversions.

- Execute customer follow-up and reactivation campaigns.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve existing CRM processes.

- Monitor and report performance.



We want someone who understands how to use a CRM to generate revenue—not someone who simply enters data.



3. Community Outreach & Referral Partnerships



- Proactively contact veterinarians, apartment communities, pet stores, and other local businesses.

- Develop relationships that generate new customer referrals.

- Confidently make outbound calls, present partnership opportunities, and handle objections.

- Create consistent follow-up processes for potential partners.

- Develop and execute customer referral programs.

- Track which partnerships and campaigns generate paying customers.



You should already be comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities.



4. Customer Retention & Reactivation



- Reengage inactive customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Execute targeted
 and SMS campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to increase customer retention.

- Encourage and track customer referrals.

- Improve communication throughout the customer experience.

- Measure campaign results and continuously improve performance.



5. Marketing & Online Community Engagement



- Promote Boarding & Beyond in relevant local
 groups and online communities.

- Create and schedule social media posts using photos and videos we provide.

- Encourage authentic customer reviews and monitor online reputation.

Paid advertising, website development, and advanced technical CRM development are handled separately.



Your focus is execution that produces customers and revenue—not marketing activity for its own sake.





Who We're Looking For



We want an experienced, highly capable professional with a demonstrated history of success.



You Must Already Be Strong In:



Sales & Closing

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident, persuasive phone communication with U.S. customers.

- Strong lead follow-up and objection-handling skills.

- A demonstrated ability to convert inquiries into paying customers.

- The ability to independently manage sales conversations from initial contact through booking.



CRM & Customer Relationship Management

- Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-up using CRM software.

- Understanding of how to improve sales conversion through effective follow-up.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to recognize sales process problems and recommend practical solutions.



Marketing & Business Development

- Experience executing marketing or customer acquisition initiatives.

- Ability to research prospects, conduct outreach, and develop relationships.

- Understanding of referrals, retention, and customer engagement.

- Ability to measure performance and improve results.



Independent Execution & Ownership

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize high-impact work without constant supervision.

- Initiative to identify and solve problems independently.

- A track record of reliably completing commitments.

- A genuine desire to improve performance and contribute ideas.





We care far more about demonstrated performance than degrees, certifications, or impressive-sounding job titles.



You don't need to know the pet care industry. But you should already be highly competent in the core sales, communication, CRM, and marketing skills this position requires.





How We Operate



We give our team clear goals, tools, and the opportunity to take ownership. In return, we expect professionalism, accountability, and excellent execution.



Our operating principles are:



- Customer First: Every interaction should create value and build trust.

- Results Over Activity: We measure outcomes, not how busy you are.

- Own the Outcome: Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through.

- Focus on What Matters: Prioritize the work that generates the greatest impact.

- Raise the Standard: Deliver excellent work and continuously improve.

- Move Fast: Execute, measure, learn, and improve.

- Zero Silent Failures: Communicate problems early and bring a recovery plan.

- No Proof = Not Done: Use Asana to document commitments, deadlines, completed work, and results.

- Build Better Systems: Improve processes instead of repeatedly working around problems.



We don't believe great people need to be micromanaged. We believe they need clear expectations, the right tools, and the opportunity to perform.



How Success Is Measured



You'll have a written performance scorecard with clearly defined goals.



Success includes:



- Higher percentages of qualified inquiries converted into paying customers.

- More customers generated through follow-up and reactivation.

- More paying customers from referrals and local partnerships.

- Improved customer retention and repeat bookings.

- Better customer service and sales call quality.

- Accurate CRM management and consistent follow-through.

- Successful execution of marketing initiatives that generate measurable business results.



Your results—not simply your activity—will determine your performance.



Compensation: Exceptional Results Deserve Exceptional Rewards



We believe talented people who create meaningful business results should have the opportunity to earn more.



Monthly Compensation (USD)

- Guaranteed Base Salary: $1,000/month

- On-Target Earnings: $3,000/month total

- Exceptional Performance: Up to $4,000/month total



Performance bonuses are based on agreed-upon, measurable business results. Specific goals, bonus calculations, and eligibility will be established in a written performance scorecard. Bonus earnings are not guaranteed.



Produce more value. Earn more.





How to Apply

We care more about demonstrated performance, initiative, and results than degrees or certifications.

title: Property Manager/Vendor Coordination
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: up to $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Vendor Coordination/Property Manager to own that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos. 

Keep sites customer-ready: gates, locks, cameras, lighting, cleanliness, and curb appeal meet SteelSafe standards. 

Handle property projects end‑to‑end (example: order a sign, coordinate install, confirm with proof). 



What you own (outcomes): 

Median Time‑to‑Rent‑Ready (TTRR) after move‑out. 

Rent‑Ready Unit % stays high and trending up. 

Work orders are dispatched quickly, completed quickly, and closed with proof. 

BOTG tasks are completed on time with proof, and contractor records and payments stay current. 

Publish a weekly scorecard that identifies misses, drives action, and holds owners accountable. 



The authority and tools you’ll have: 

You have the authority to improve the operation: turn workflows, proof standards, BOTG and vendor performance, inspection schedules, and the systems used to keep properties Rent-Ready. 

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof). 



This role is a fit if you: 

Take initiative. Act fast. Identify problems, make sound decisions, and act within your authority without waiting for instructions. Clear your blockers fast. Move with relentless urgency.  

Own the outcome. Delegating work doesn't delegate responsibility. When contractors fail or projects stall, find another solution and see it through.  

Deliver results, not activity. We don't measure effort, calls, or hours worked. We measure problems solved and jobs completed.  

Demand excellence. Hold yourself, your team, and contractors to high standards. Done means done right, on time, and verified.  

Communicate early. Raise problems before they become missed deadlines. No surprises, excuses, or hidden problems.  

Fix the root cause. Don't just solve today's problem. Build simple systems that prevent it from happening again.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.

title: Student Accounts & Collections Officer
description:
Company: Alpha Technical Training

Employment Type: Part-time

Work Arrangement: Remote / Offshore

Industry: Vocational Education & Training (Australia)



ABOUT THE ROLE:



Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

- Ability to build rapport while maintaining a clear collection objective.

- Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving ability.

- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.

- Ability to work independently and achieve collection targets.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE:



- Experience collecting education or training fees.

- Experience working with Australian customers.

- Experience negotiating instalment arrangements.

- Familiarity with 
 or similar CRM platforms.

title: Mobile First Landing Page Designer | UI/UX & CRO Specialist
description:
We are a UK based digital services business looking for an exceptionally talented mobile-first landing page designer to join our growing team.



Our business, Win Your PIP, provides digital guidance and personalised writing support to help people navigate the UK Personal Independence Payment (PIP) application process.



We are developing multiple customer acquisition funnels using
, Google Ads and other digital marketing channels.



We already have a dedicated web developer and an established content and marketing strategy.



We are not looking for another developer. We are looking for someone who knows how to turn good content into beautifully designed, high-converting mobile landing pages.



Our current website/landing page:







Please review this page before applying.



What We're Looking For



Our current landing page has strong content, customer psychology and a clearly structured offer.



However, we believe the mobile design is holding back its potential.



The page currently feels too lengthy, with oversized headings, competing text, excessive card spacing and sections that don't flow naturally into one another.



We want someone who understands that great landing page design isn't simply about looking attractive. It's about guiding a customer towards taking action.



You should understand how customers behave when arriving from paid advertisements, how to build trust, how to reduce hesitation and how to present information in a way that feels effortless to navigate.



We're looking for a polished, modern, SaaS-inspired visual experience, tailored to our audience and service.



Your Responsibilities



1. Design conversion focused landing pages



Create engaging, mobile first landing pages built around specific audiences, advertising messages and customer needs.



Translate existing copy, research and marketing briefs into persuasive visual layouts.



Establish clear customer journeys from the opening headline through to the final call to action.



Design for purchases, enquiries, lead generation and other measurable conversion goals.



Ensure the landing page experience reflects the advertisement that brought the visitor there.



2. Own the mobile UI/UX design



Create exceptional typography, visual hierarchy and spacing.



Ensure headlines, supporting copy, imagery and buttons work together rather than compete for attention.



Reduce unnecessary scrolling, clutter and cognitive overload.



Make text-heavy information feel simple, professional and engaging.



Design responsive layouts that work particularly well on mobile devices.



Consider accessibility and usability for older and less technologically confident customers.



3. Apply conversion rate optimisation principles



Understand above-the-fold design, customer psychology, trust signals, offer presentation and CTA placement.



Identify friction points that may prevent users from progressing or purchasing.



Use clear visual storytelling, persuasive design and appropriate social proof.



Recommend layout changes informed by user behaviour and conversion data.



Produce design variations for A/B testing.



Work with our marketing team to continuously improve landing-page performance.



4. Build reusable Figma design systems



Create complete, fully editable Figma landing-page designs.



Develop reusable sections, layouts, components and templates.



Establish consistent typography styles, spacing, colours and responsive design rules.



Create a component library that can be adapted for multiple landing pages and advertising campaigns.



Use Figma Auto Layout, components and variants to support efficient future design work.



5. Prepare professional developer handoffs



Deliver organised Figma files containing editable text, headings, images, buttons and components.



Provide clear specifications for our existing developer.



Include desktop and mobile layouts where required.



Explain responsive behaviour and interactive elements.



Review the implemented design and identify any visual discrepancies.



You will not be responsible for coding, building or deploying websites. Our existing developer handles all implementation.



Essential Requirements



Proven experience specifically designing mobile-first landing pages.



Advanced Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components and design systems.



Strong understanding of CRO and direct-response marketing.



Excellent typography, visual hierarchy and composition.



Experience designing landing pages for
, Instagram or Google Ads traffic.



Ability to design lead-generation funnels, sales pages, product/service offer pages and checkout-focused journeys.



Ability to work from existing content and translate it into a cohesive, high-quality design.



Experience preparing developer-ready Figma files.



Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions.



Portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile landing-page design, not just desktop websites.



Highly Desirable



Previous work on high-converting SaaS, DTC, digital-product or service-based landing pages.



Experience working alongside media buyers, marketers or conversion strategists.



Understanding of A/B testing, heatmaps and user behaviour analytics.



Ability to explain previous design improvements using conversion results.



Experience building reusable landing-page template libraries.



Familiarity with accessibility and designing for older audiences.



Recruitment Task



As part of your application, please take our existing landing page:







And show us how you would transform it into a beautifully designed, mobile-optimised, conversion-focused landing page in Figma. This doesnt need to be the final version, we just need to see you understand our request.



Our existing content and customer journey have already been developed.



Your responsibility is to reimagine the visual experience and demonstrate what you can do.



We are particularly concerned with:



Oversized headings and inconsistent typography.



Too much competing information on mobile.



Excessive scrolling and unnecessarily large cards.



Lack of visual flow between sections.



Generic layouts that feel assembled rather than professionally designed.



Making the page more engaging, trustworthy and easier to navigate towards purchase.



We want somebody who can bring independent creative thinking to these problems, not simply rearrange our existing boxes.



Please provide:



A proposed redesign of part or all of the current page in Figma.



A brief written explanation of the biggest design issues you identify.



An explanation of what you changed, why you made those decisions and how your redesign improves the existing experience.



Your approach to improving typography, content hierarchy, visual flow and CTA positioning.



An explanation of the purpose behind your design choices and how you believe they would help customers navigate the page and convert.



A design output you can realistically provide within the time available.



This is your opportunity to show us what you can do. We are interested in both the quality of the design and your ability to communicate your thinking clearly in writing.



If you have any other portfolio work, please feel free to send us information about other landing pages you have designed, particularly pages created to generate purchases or leads.



This does not need to be a completed landing-page design. We are looking for an initial concept that demonstrates your creative thinking and understanding of our requirements.



Shortlisted applicants will be d
 and contacted regarding the next stage.



Long-Term Opportunity



Our intention is to establish a reusable mobile conversion design system that can support multiple landing pages across our business.



Future projects include landing pages for different customer audiences, Google Ads campaigns,
 advertising funnels, condition-specific campaigns and our associated charity website.



Once the initial design system has been established, we want to create and test new landing-page variations efficiently.



This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person to take ownership of our landing-page visual design.



We value excellent work, reliable communication, strong creative thinking and continuous improvement.



This is a freelance role built around trust and responsibility. The relevant specification will be sent to you, and we expect you to complete the work in the manner discussed and to the agreed standard.



Payment will be made through Wise or alternative payment routes on a weekly basis for the first four weeks, and then on a monthly basis after that.



How to Apply



Please
 your application directly to:







 subject: Mobile CRO Designer – Your Name



Please include:



1. Your portfolio



Provide links to 2–3 mobile landing pages you have personally designed, preferably with editable Figma examples or mobile screenshots.



We are particularly interested in commercial landing pages designed to generate purchases or leads.



2. Your conversion design experience



Briefly explain how you approach conversion-focused mobile design.



If you have previous conversion results, A/B testing examples or measurable improvements, please share them.



3. Your proposed redesign of our current page



Please review:







Complete the recruitment task described above and send us your initial redesign concept, along with your written explanation of:



The biggest design issues you identify.



What you changed and why.



How you improved the mobile conversion experience.



Your approach to typography, content hierarchy, visual flow and CTA positioning.



The purpose behind your design decisions.



How you believe your proposed design would help customers navigate the page and encourage conversions.



If you have any other portfolio work, please feel free to send us information about other landing pages you have designed.



4. Your availability and rate



Please confirm your preferred monthly part-time rate, approximate weekly availability and the level of design output you could realistically provide.



We're particularly interested in how efficiently you can produce new landing-page variations once reusable Figma templates have been established.



What Success Looks Like



We're looking for someone who can take a content-heavy landing page and make it feel:



Simple. Modern. Trustworthy. Intuitive. Engaging. Conversion-focused.



Someone who understands that the best design guides the customer's attention rather than competing for it.



If you have a strong eye for exceptional mobile design and genuinely understand conversion psychology, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply by
ing 
 with your portfolio, experience and initial redesign ideas.

title: Medical Billing and Credentialing Specialist
description:
About the role:



Avita Integrative Care and Avita Psychological Care are psychology group practices serving New Jersey and New York. We are hiring an experienced specialist with a proven record in U.S. insurance billing, claims resolution, accounts receivable, and clinician credentialing.



Mental health billing is strongly preferred. Psychological or neuropsychological testing and assessment billing is a major plus.

You will join our existing remote billing team and collaborate with our intake coordinator, clinicians, and practice leadership.



What you will do:

- Perform Verification of Benefits (VOB) using our existing online platforms and payer portals, and make direct calls to payers when phone verification or clarification is needed. Document eligibility, covered services, client cost sharing, authorization requirements, and relevant limitations.

- Review and submit accurate claims using EHR systems (TherapyNotes); Independently resolve rejections, denials, underpayments, and unpaid claims through payer calls, corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals.

- Investigate and challenge insurance recoupments and clawbacks: assess payer reasons, coordinate supporting records, develop case-specific dispute and appeal strategies, and track response deadlines. Identify root causes and implement preventive checks for eligibility, authorizations, coding, provider enrollment, and documentation in collaboration with clinicians and billing colleagues.

- Monitor aging reports, prioritize overdue accounts and filing deadlines, and maintain a documented next action and follow-up date for unresolved claims.

- Review EOBs and ERAs, investigate payment discrepancies, and help reconcile posted payments and client balances.

- Handle clinician and group credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH maintenance, re-credentialing, and group affiliations. Track applications through confirmed participation and effective dates.

- Resolve client billing questions with patience and clear explanations of insurance payments, deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and balances.

- Coordinate assigned accounts and handoffs with other virtual billing colleagues; maintain accurate shared records and flag issues needing escalation.

- Monitor official payer updates affecting New York and New Jersey billing, telehealth, authorizations, testing, and provider eligibility; communicate relevant changes to the team.

- Provide weekly updates on aging balances, resolved claims, credentialing progress, and outstanding issues.



Required experience and skills:

- At least three years of direct U.S. medical insurance billing experience, including benefits verification, plus hands-on clinician credentialing and payer enrollment experience.

- Demonstrated success resolving denied or aging claims and completing insurance panel enrollments.

- Proven experience disputing insurance recoupments or clawbacks, developing effective resolution strategies, and implementing measures to reduce future recoupment risk.

- Current working knowledge of New York and New Jersey payer processes and the ability to independently verify plan-specific requirements.

- Working knowledge of CPT and ICD-10 terminology, modifiers, authorizations, EOBs, ERAs, coordination of benefits, and filing and appeal deadlines.

- Excellent spoken and written English, confident payer phone communication, respectful client service, and reliable collaboration with a remote team.



Especially helpful experience:

- Mental health or behavioral health group-practice billing.

- Psychological or neuropsychological testing billing, including authorizations, time and unit requirements, and primary and add-on code relationships.

- TherapyNotes, CAQH, Availity, clearinghouses, and payer portals.

- Aetna, Cigna or Evernorth, Horizon BCBS, UnitedHealthcare or Optum, Oxford, or Carelon.



Schedule and secure workspace:

You must be available throughout the agreed U.S. Eastern working hours for payer calls, client support, and team communication. The schedule follows U.S. Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes.



You will need:

- Reliable high-speed internet on a private, secured network, with a backup plan for internet and power interruptions.

- A modern computer capable of running multiple billing applications and voice or video calls reliably.

- A supported operating system with current security updates, security software, encrypted storage, multifactor authentication, and automatic screen locking.

- A quiet, private workspace, professional headset, and webcam.

- Familiarity with HIPAA confidentiality requirements and willingness to follow practice-approved security and remote access procedures.



How to apply:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume and brief answers to these questions:

1. How many years have you handled U.S. insurance billing and credentialing? Which New York or New Jersey payers have you worked with?

2. Describe one denied or aging claim you resolved: the problem, your actions, and the result.

3. Describe one clinician credentialing or enrollment you completed: the payer, your responsibilities, and how you confirmed the effective date.

4. Describe an insurance recoupment or clawback you challenged: your strategy, the outcome, and steps you took to reduce future recoupment risk.

5. What mental health or testing billing experience and billing systems experience do you have?

6. Confirm your availability for the stated shift, earliest start date, expected rate, and computer, internet, and backup setup.

Use examples without patient identifiers or confidential employer information. Shortlisted applicants may complete a brief exercise using fictional billing scenarios.
