title: QuickBooks ProAdvisor – Accounting Reviewer & Administrative Support (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)
description:
IMPORTANT: ALL AI-GENERATED APPLICATION RESPONSES WILL BE IMMEDIATELY REJECTED AND WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED. We are looking for applicants who personally read this job description and write their own original responses based on their actual experience and qualifications.



HIRING PREFERENCE: Priority will be given to applicants currently residing anywhere in North America, Central America, the Caribbean, or South America. Applicants from other regions are also welcome to apply and will be considered based on their qualifications, relevant experience, and ability to consistently follow our required Pacific Time (PT) work schedule.



JOB TITLE: QuickBooks ProAdvisor – Accounting Reviewer & Administrative Support (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)



JOB OVERVIEW



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented QuickBooks Online (QBO) ProAdvisor to join our team as an Accounting Reviewer and Administrative Support Specialist.



This role is ideal for an accounting professional with strong technical knowledge, excellent analytical skills, and hands-on experience reviewing financial statements and QuickBooks Online files for accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment.



You will work closely with our bookkeeping team to review weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end financials, identify discrepancies, provide constructive feedback, and maintain the quality and accuracy of our clients’ accounting records.



This position starts at 20–25 hours per week, with the potential to transition to a full-time role based on performance, business needs, and mutual fit.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of the review process, identify issues without constant supervision, communicate findings clearly, and consistently maintain high accounting standards.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. FINANCIAL STATEMENT AND PERIOD-END REVIEWS

* Review weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial statements and accounting reports.

* Review period-end financials submitted through our firm's client portal.

* Verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of financial statements.

* Identify unusual balances, discrepancies, misclassifications, and potential accounting errors.

* Verify that balance sheet accounts are properly reconciled and supported by appropriate documentation.

* Review profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and other financial reports for accuracy and reasonableness.

* Provide clear, actionable feedback on issues identified during the review process.



2. QUICKBOOKS ONLINE REVIEW AND QUALITY CONTROL

* Review client QuickBooks Online (QBO) files for accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment.

* Evaluate account classifications, journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

* Identify missing transactions, incorrect postings, unreconciled accounts, and other inconsistencies.

* Assess the overall quality and reliability of clients’ accounting records.

* Recommend adjustments, corrections, and process improvements when necessary.



3. BOOKKEEPER PERFORMANCE MONITORING

* Track and monitor bookkeepers’ accounting review scores and performance trends.

* Maintain organized records of review findings, recurring errors, and areas for improvement.

* Provide constructive, professional, and actionable feedback to bookkeepers.

* Identify recurring mistakes and recommend corrective actions or additional training.

* Help establish and maintain consistent accounting review standards across the team.



4. TAX RETURN TIE-OUTS

* Tie out tax return figures to the corresponding QuickBooks Online records and financial statements.

* Verify that key balances and financial figures agree with accounting records and tax return workpapers.

* Investigate and document discrepancies between the books and tax reporting figures.

* Coordinate with appropriate team members to resolve outstanding differences.



5. ACCOUNTING ANALYTICS AND FINANCIAL REVIEW

* Perform accounting analytics to identify unusual fluctuations, trends, and potential errors.

* Compare financial results across periods and investigate significant variances.

* Identify inconsistent account activity, unusual transactions, and items requiring further review.

* Provide insights and recommendations to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting.



6. ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT

* Access assigned client files through our firm's client portal, review submissions, and track outstanding items.

* Maintain accurate documentation of review findings, corrections, and follow-up actions.

* Monitor assigned reviews and communicate outstanding issues promptly.

* Assist with other accounting review, quality control, reporting, and administrative tasks as needed.

* Help improve internal accounting workflows, review procedures, and quality assurance processes.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Familiarity with accounting workflow and practice management portals.

* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and U.S. accounting practices.

* Proven experience in accounting, bookkeeping review, financial reporting, or public accounting.

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (QBO). QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification is strongly preferred.

* Solid understanding of accrual accounting, month-end and year-end closing procedures, and financial statement preparation.

* Experience reviewing balance sheets, profit and loss statements, general ledgers, and account reconciliations.

* Familiarity with financial statement review procedures and internal quality control processes.

* Experience reviewing tax returns and tying tax figures back to accounting records.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify accounting errors, discrepancies, and inconsistencies.

* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality work.

* Strong written communication skills, particularly when documenting issues and providing feedback.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple client files, and meet deadlines.

* Professionalism and the ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.

* Experience in a CPA firm, accounting firm, or multi-client bookkeeping environment.

* Experience evaluating bookkeeper performance and providing technical accounting guidance.



WORK SCHEDULE AND GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

Initial commitment: Approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Position type: Part-time, with the potential to transition to full-time.

Work arrangement: Remote.

Required schedule (Pacific Time):

* Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday: 11:00 AM–3:00 PM or 12:00 PM–4:00 PM.

* Wednesday: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.

* Mandatory weekly team meeting every Wednesday.



You must be able to follow the agreed schedule, attend mandatory meetings, coordinate with the team, and meet deadlines.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship with our firm.

The role may expand into a full-time position as our firm grows and the successful candidate demonstrates strong performance, reliability, initiative, and the ability to take ownership of the accounting review function.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We want more than someone who simply checks numbers. We need an accounting professional who can think critically, identify problems before they become bigger issues, uphold high accounting standards, and help our bookkeepers continuously improve.



The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, dependable, analytical, and comfortable working with multiple client files. You should be able to recognize when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and communicate your findings clearly and professionally.



We value accuracy, accountability, initiative, independent problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement.



This is a hands-on accounting review role. We expect you to apply your own accounting knowledge and judgment, not simply rely on automated tools or follow checklists without understanding the underlying transactions.



HOW TO APPLY

Please read the entire job description carefully before submitting your application. Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be considered.



To confirm that you have personally read this job description, include the exact code below in the subject line of your application or proposal: abblrocks

Applications without this exact subject line will be rejected.



Please address each of the following in your application using your own words (please make it short and direct to the point):



1. LOCATION: What country and city do you currently reside in?



2. ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE: Briefly describe your relevant accounting experience and professional qualifications.



3. QUICKBOOKS ONLINE: Explain your hands-on experience with QBO, including any ProAdvisor certification you hold.



4. FINANCIAL STATEMENT REVIEWS: Describe your experience reviewing financial statements and identifying accounting discrepancies.



5. TAX RETURN TIE-OUTS: Explain your experience reconciling tax return figures with accounting records.



6. U.S. ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE: Describe your experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounting firms.



7. AVAILABILITY AND RATE: State your weekly availability, ability to follow the required schedule, and proposed hourly rate.



8. PROBLEM-SOLVING EXAMPLE: Share a brief example of an accounting issue you personally identified during a review, how you investigated it, and what you did to resolve it. Do not disclose confidential client information.



We value specific examples and genuine explanations over generic statements. Your answers should reflect your actual experience and demonstrate your ability to perform the responsibilities outlined above.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND PERSONAL WORK REQUIREMENTS

This engagement involves highly confidential personal and business financial information. All work must be performed personally by the selected freelancer.



Delegation, subcontracting, the use of assistants, and unauthorized third-party access to client information or accounting systems are strictly prohibited.



You must be able to work independently, protect sensitive client data, follow our internal procedures, and take personal responsibility for the quality and accuracy of your work.



FINAL NOTE

We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and technically strong accounting professional who takes initiative, communicates clearly, identifies problems independently, and follows through on solutions.



If you have the experience, judgment, and attention to detail required for this role, we encourage you to apply with a thoughtful, personalized proposal that demonstrates your qualifications.



We look forward to finding a strong accounting professional who can contribute to our team's success and grow with our firm.

title: AI UGC Scriptwriter
description:
About the Role



We’re hiring a part-time AI UGC Scriptwriter to join our growing content production team.



We specialize in creating AI-generated UGC-style videos for beauty, skincare, and haircare brands.



Our creative director will provide reference videos, scripts, and creative direction. Your responsibility is to adapt those references into engaging, ready-to-produce scripts tailored to different AI avatars, brand voices, and ideal customer profiles (ICPs).



This is a writing-focused position. You won’t be responsible for finding reference videos, editing videos, or generating AI visuals.



We’re looking for someone who knows how to use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT effectively while understanding what makes short-form video content engaging and persuasive.



Responsibilities



* Review reference videos and creative instructions provided by our team.

* Understand each avatar’s personality, speaking style, and ideal customer profile (ICP).

* Use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools to adapt reference scripts.

* Preserve the original reference’s hook, structure, pacing, and creative concept unless instructed otherwise.

* Adapt dialogue naturally to match the assigned avatar and target audience.

* Incorporate the correct brand and product information into each script.

* Review and refine AI-generated scripts to ensure they sound natural and conversational.

* Check scripts for inaccurate product information, unsupported claims, and inconsistencies.

* Include scene directions and visual instructions when requested.

* Complete 8 finalized scripts per working day, 6 days per week.

* Make revisions based on feedback.

* Communicate proactively about questions, issues, or delays.



You’re a Good Fit If You:



* Write in clear, natural, fluent English.

* Have experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar AI writing tools.

* Understand what makes short-form video hooks engaging.

* Can take an existing reference script and adapt it without losing the original creative direction.

* Can write natural dialogue that doesn’t sound overly robotic or AI-generated.

* Are detail-oriented and capable of following specific creative instructions.

* Are organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.



Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels, AI UGC, or direct-response advertising is a plus.



Tools You’ll Use



* Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini — AI-assisted scriptwriting.

* Google Drive — Reference videos and shared assets.

* Google Docs — Script submissions and revisions.

* 
 / WhatsApp — Team communication, daily updates, and feedback.



What We Provide



* Reference videos and creative direction for each assignment.

* Established AI avatar identities and target audience profiles.

* Brand guidelines, product information, and writing examples.

* Training on our scriptwriting workflow.

* Regular feedback to help improve your writing.

* Opportunities to take on additional work as our team grows.



Compensation



* $100–$200 USD monthly base, depending on experience and skill level.

* Workload: 8 finalized scripts per day, 6 days per week.

* Estimated hours: 14 hours per week.

* Schedule: Flexible, based on completing assigned scripts.



As our production team expands, we may increase output to 12 scripts per day, with corresponding adjustments to compensation.



How to Apply



Send a message or apply to this job AND complete the application questionnaire below:







The questionnaire includes a mandatory AI scriptwriting recreation assignment.



We'll only consider applicants who complete the questionnaire and assignment.



We’re not just looking at the final script. We want to understand how you think, follow creative direction, and use AI tools to produce high-quality content.

title: Cold Caller, US Property Owners (Real Estate / Property Management)
description:

- Never call a number marked DNC.

- All calls are recorded. You will state this at the start of calls to numbers outside Michigan.

- At least 2 years of outbound cold calling to US consumers

- Real estate or property management calling strongly preferred

- Clear, natural spoken English and strong objection handling

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet and a backup power source

- Available 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday (11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time)



Pay

- $5.00 per hour, paid biweekly through Payoneer

- One-week unpaid trial after hire

- Performance and rate review at 3 to 6 months



How to apply

1. Start your application with the word Detroit.

2. Attach or link one or two recordings of real outbound calls you made to US homeowners or property owners. Remove or bleep the other person's name and number.

3. Tell us in two sentences what real estate calling you have done and for whom.



Applications without a call recording will not be reviewed.



Before any offer, shortlisted applicants complete a short Loom video, two references from direct supervisors, an assessment, an interview, and a short paid test calling block on our list.

title: Purchasing Agent (NetSuite) - Own Every PO & Push Back on Vendors
description:
We're a US flooring and tile distributor based in Dallas, TX. We need a purchasing agent who OWNS this job - not someone who just processes it.



READ THIS FIRST

This role is not for someone who waits for instructions. We want someone who:

- Questions a vendor price increase instead of accepting it

- Catches errors before they reach a PO, and asks when something doesn't add up

- Chases late shipments without being reminded

- Tells us about a problem early, along with a proposed fix

- Is comfortable telling a vendor no, and comfortable telling us when something's wrong



If you'd rather keep your head down and stay quiet, this isn't the job for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own purchasing end to end in NetSuite: PO creation, tracking, receipt and data accuracy

- Negotiate. Treat every vendor price as negotiable and fight increases on timing, volume or substitutions

- Track lead times and escalate delays immediately

- Verify and upload vendor price lists, including bulk CSV uploads

- Manage customer orders that require procurement: send status updates and coordinate delivery with our warehouse and logistics teams

- Cover quoting and order intake when needed



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of purchasing or procurement experience in distribution or manufacturing

- Hands-on NetSuite experience (required): POs, vendor records, inventory and CSV imports

- Strong Excel skills

- Fluent, confident spoken and written English

- Must work US Central business hours (8am-5pm CT), Monday to Friday

- Import experience (tile, stone, LVT) is a plus



ENGAGEMENT

Full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term. Paid trial period first.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Vantage" and answer these:

1. A vendor
s a 6% price increase effective in two weeks. Write the actual reply you would send them.

2. Tell us about a time you pushed back on a vendor, a customer, or your boss. What happened?

3. You're entering a PO and the item cost doesn't match the last PO. What do you do?

4. Describe your NetSuite experience: which transactions did you create day to day, and have you done CSV imports?

5. Can you reliably work 8am-5pm US Central, Monday to Friday?



Applications that don't start with "Vantage" will be skipped, because following instructions is part of this job.

Experience: Heavy Steel Fabrication Estimating Experience – Trusses, Chutes, Process Piping, Frames and Structural Steel and associated QA/QC processes – minimum 2 years Australian experience.



About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator – Heavy Steel Fabrication & Quality Support to join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering business, providing dedicated support to the existing Senior Estimator and Project Management team.



This is a hybrid role, with approximately 70% focused on Estimator Support and 30% on Quality Support.



The primary focus is assisting the existing Senior Estimator with estimates, material take-offs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, tender documentation, and other estimating requirements for complex steel fabrication projects.



Experience with heavy steel fabrication is essential. We are looking for someone who understands the practical requirements, complexity, and quality standards involved in fabrication work such as structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, and process piping. Experience supporting projects in heavy industry, mining, oil and gas, or similar environments is valuable, but direct employment by a mining or oil and gas company is not required.



The role also provides quality support across projects, including QA documentation, NDT requests, MDRs, weld maps, material traceability, and maintaining welding and quality registers.



The ideal candidate is a hands-on steel fabrication estimator with a strong understanding of fabrication processes and associated QA/QC documentation. They should be able to interpret drawings, prepare accurate estimates, and recognise the relevant quality requirements with minimal training.



This is not a standalone Senior Estimator position. The successful candidate will work as a hands-on support resource, stepping in to assist with estimating and quality requirements as needed while working closely with the existing team.



Key Responsibilities

1. Heavy Steel Fabrication & Technical Support

- Read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Estimate fabrication work involving structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, and similar heavy steel fabrication.

- Understand fabrication methods, material specifications, welding requirements, and associated labour and machinery requirements.

- Assess the scope and complexity of fabrication work to support accurate estimating and pricing.

- Review job packs, drawings, and specifications to identify materials, fabrication requirements, and quality considerations.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential technical or fabrication issues before estimates are submitted.

- Understand how fabrication methods and project specifications affect costs, production requirements, and quality documentation.

- Liaise with the estimating, operations, project management, and quality teams to clarify technical requirements.



2. Estimator Support – Primary Focus

- Support the existing Senior Estimator with day-to-day estimating activities.

- Review client RFQs, engineering drawings, specifications, and project documentation.

- Interpret technical requirements and identify information requiring clarification.

- Prepare detailed Material Take-Offs (MTOs).

- Calculate material quantities and prepare cutting lists and other fabrication-related documentation.

- Assess material, machinery, labour, fabrication, and other project requirements.

- Assist with detailed estimates, cost calculations, and pricing for heavy steel fabrication work.

- Obtain and compare supplier pricing for materials and fabrication requirements.

- Liaise with suppliers to obtain current and accurate material costs.

- Assist with preparing quotations, proposals, and tender submissions.

- Review estimates for accuracy, scope, quantities, and pricing before submission.

- Assist with quote revisions, variations, and changes to project requirements.

- Support the Senior Estimator with tender deadlines and estimating workload.

- Provide estimating coverage when required.



3. Quality & Documentation Support – Approximately 30%

- Support the Quality function across active projects as required.

- Review job packs, drawings, specifications, and fabrication requirements to identify applicable QA/QC documentation.

- Prepare Weld Maps by identifying appropriate weld procedures and marking welds on drawings and weld traceability documentation.

- Prepare QA Packs for client submission and approval.

- Compile proposed weld procedures, welder qualifications, and supporting reports for project documentation.

- Prepare NDT requests and coordinate associated documentation.

- Prepare Welder Qualification Requests where required.

- Follow up with suppliers for material certificates and surface treatment reports.

- Prepare Manufacturer's Data Reports (MDRs).

- Track outstanding MDRs for completed projects and ensure they are submitted on time.

- Maintain accurate records of welder qualifications and welding documentation.

- Maintain the Welder Qualification Register, including weld reports and upcoming requalification requirements.

- Maintain the Weld Procedure Register and update it when new procedures are received.

- Assist with material traceability, delivery dockets, and related project documentation.

- Help ensure quality documentation aligns with project specifications, fabrication requirements, and client requirements.



4. Project & Team Support

- Work closely with the Senior Estimator, Project Managers, Operations, and Quality personnel.

- Provide estimating and quality support across multiple projects as priorities change.

- Participate in online meetings, drawing reviews, and project discussions.

- Proactively communicate progress, outstanding information, pricing issues, quality requirements, and potential risks.

- Raise issues early and seek clarification rather than allowing problems to delay estimates or project documentation.

- Assist Project Managers with project documentation, variations, and technical information where required.

- Help ensure a smooth handover from estimating through to project delivery.

- Provide support across estimating and quality functions when required.



Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years of Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating experience.

- Demonstrated hands-on estimating experience involving heavy steel fabrication, including structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, or comparable fabrication work.

- Strong understanding of steel fabrication estimating, including materials, labour, machinery, welding, and fabrication requirements.

- Demonstrated experience preparing MTOs, estimates, quotations, or tender submissions.

- Ability to read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Sound understanding of heavy fabrication processes and the practical requirements of complex fabrication projects.

- Working knowledge of associated QA/QC processes, quality requirements, material traceability, and fabrication documentation.

- Experience with quality documentation, quality control, or quality assurance processes.

- Ability to create or interpret Weld Maps and weld traceability documentation.

- Familiarity with NDT requests, QA Packs, MDRs, welder qualifications, and welding registers.

- Understanding of how project specifications and fabrication requirements affect quality documentation.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with estimating or digital take-off software.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to communication, problem-solving, and teamwork.

- Comfortable working remotely and collaborating daily with an Australian team.



Highly Desirable

- Experience estimating heavy fabrication projects for industrial, mining, oil and gas, resources, or similar sectors.

- Extensive Australian steel fabrication experience across structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, or - comparable work.

- Experience across both estimating and quality control/quality assurance functions.

- Experience preparing QA Packs and MDRs for Australian projects.

- Experience with NDT coordination, welding documentation, and material traceability.

- Experience maintaining welder qualification and weld procedure registers.

- Understanding of carbon steel welding, with exposure to stainless steel, duplex steel, wear plate, or other specialised steels.

- Previous experience supporting Project Managers or Operations teams.

- Engineering degree, steel trade qualification, or relevant technical qualification.

- Experience with Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit, PlanSwift, or similar estimating and take-off software.



What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will become a reliable second layer of support for the existing estimating and project team.



Success means:

- Producing accurate and timely estimates for complex heavy steel fabrication work.

- Understanding fabrication scope, drawings, material requirements, and quality considerations with minimal training.

- Keeping MTOs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, and tender documentation organised and up to date.

- Helping the Senior Estimator manage estimating workload and deadlines.

- Providing dependable quality support when required.

- Ensuring QA Packs, MDRs, NDT requests, Weld Maps, and registers are completed accurately and on time.

- Identifying technical, estimating, and quality issues early and communicating proactively.

- Moving comfortably between estimating, project coordination, and quality documentation as business priorities require.



The Opportunity

- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering team.

- Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Estimator and Project Managers.

- Approximately 70% Estimator Support / 30% Quality Support.

- Work on technically challenging steel fabrication projects.

- Opportunity to develop across estimating, project coordination, and quality functions.

- Long-term opportunity within a collaborative and technically focused team.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description:
Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator



We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects.



The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework.



Primary Responsibilities



* Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements.

* Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication.

* Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts.

* Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs.

* Determine the number of slabs required for each project.

* Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities.

* Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity.

* Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required.

* Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication.

* Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers.

* Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation.

* Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements.



Required Experience



* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD.

* Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform.

* Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry.

* Ability to read architectural and structural plans.

* Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations.

* Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts.

* Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software.

* Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer.

* Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation.

* Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus.

* Familiarity with exterior cladding, mechanical fastening, adhered veneer, and large-format stone installation is highly desirable.



Required Work Samples



Applicants must provide examples of:



* AutoCAD shop drawings

* Architectural elevations and details

* Slab layouts or cutting diagrams

* Material takeoffs or cut lists

* Relevant 3D models or renderings



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who combines drafting ability with practical fabrication and estimating knowledge. This person should understand not only how to draw the project, but also how the stone will be selected, cut, matched, fabricated, delivered, and installed.

title: Short-Term Rental Specialist | Executive Assistant
description:
Endless Real Estate



About Us



Endless Real Estate is a growing real estate company with three business lines: Real Estate Sales (where your Executive Assistant work sits), Endless Stays (our own premium short-term rentals across NJ, TN, FL & VA), and Endless Asset Management (short-term rental management and co-hosting for other property owners). We're growing fast with an ambitious 10-year vision — this is a career opportunity, not just a job.



Our Core Values: World-Class Hospitality to Every Guest and Owner • Fix Once, Fix Forever • Own the Outcome • Systems Create Scale • Bring Excitement, Passion, and Integrity Every Day



Please read this posting carefully. Due to applicant volume, applicants who do not follow the instructions in this posting explicitly will not be considered.



The Role



We're hiring one fully remote team member to run our short-term rental operations day to day. This role will ultimately act as Executive Assistant to the Owner — responsible for all admin and ops work across our real estate business — with a clear path into leadership as we scale.



Schedule: Thursday–Monday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch (Tuesdays and Wednesdays off).



Virtual office: You'll work camera-on in our virtual office during your shift — it's how our remote team stays connected. This one is (politely) non-negotiable.



Short-Term Rental Operations:





Own guest communication end-to-end, from inquiry through post-stay

Manage reservations across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct

Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and service providers

Monitor property conditions and uphold quality standards

Handle troubleshooting and service recovery

Execute company systems and keep documentation sharp





Executive Assistant & Admin:





Own admin and operations support for the Owner across all three business lines

Accounts payable and basic monthly prep for our bookkeepers

Admin support for social media and marketing

Qualifying calls with potential co-host clients





AI & Automation:





Learn and use AI tools — Claude and ChatGPT are part of the daily job here, and you'll be responsible for getting great at them

Work directly with our AI agents and workflows to make sure company systems and automations are running effectively

Review our AI guest-messaging tool and ensure every guest interaction is high-quality





Tech you'll use: Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude, and ChatGPT are our core ecosystem — you'll live in them daily. Property stack: Hospitable/OwnerRez (PMS), Breezeway, Quo, HostBuddy, StayFi, RankBreeze, Go High Level. We automate the repetitive work — you run the systems, catch the exceptions, and flag what we should automate next.



Who You Are





Experienced in STR — you've actually managed short-term rentals before (required)

Service-hearted — you're looking to serve and proud to be someone's right hand, always asking "what else can I do to make their life easier?"

Collaborative — you communicate proactively and make the whole team better

Growth-driven with a passion to learn — you want a career track, not a static role; we promote from within

Extremely comfortable with technology and AI — you pick up new platforms fast and work with AI tools daily; at a minimum, you'd describe yourself as extremely efficient and productive

Detail-obsessed — avid note-taker; nothing slips through

An owner — you drive outcomes and solve problems without being chased

Positive and high-energy — you bring excitement to work every single day; it's contagious and it's essential here





Hard requirement: Fluent English at a 9/10 level — written and verbal — with college-level comprehension (non-negotiable — please don't apply otherwise).



Huge plus: Notion, OwnerRez, or Hospitable experience.



What Makes This Different



This is a startup, not a steady-state job. We're building systems and evolving constantly — if you're looking for routine, this isn't the role. You'll work directly with the CEO and get hands-on mentorship and training from day one. Your work directly drives guest satisfaction, property performance, and company growth.



Compensation





Competitive salary based on experience

Performance bonuses tied to property metrics

Fully remote

Clear advancement path with increased compensation





How to Apply



Submit:





Your resume

A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, including a time you went above and beyond for a customer

Any questions you have about the position — including your salary requirements and whether they are negotiable





Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, include the word "Jersey" in the subject line.



Reminder — due to applicant volume, applications that do not follow these instructions explicitly will not be considered.



If You're Selected to Interview



Due to applicant volume, candidates selected to interview will be required to watch a 25-minute video from our CEO and record answers to 6–7 questions and scenarios before a live interview.



This opportunity will be incredible for someone who is looking to grow, wants direct mentorship and training from the CEO, and really wants to be excited to come to work every day. We move fast for the right candidates — if that's you, apply now.

title: Bookkeeper & Tax Accountant (15–20 hrs/week, Remote)
description:
We’re a small US business with two locations in California, each set up as its own company. We’re looking for an experienced bookkeeper and tax accountant to take full ownership of our books and taxes for both entities.



This isn’t a role where you’ll be handed clean books and a process to follow. Our books are behind and only partly accurate, and nothing has been set up for the newer entity yet. You’ll build the bookkeeping from the ground up, clean up the history going back to 2024, and then keep everything accurate and current month to month. You’ll report directly to the owner. He’s looking for someone who can guide him on what’s needed, not someone who needs to be told what to do.



What Matters Most to Us



You must be a CPA with hands-on experience doing bookkeeping and tax work for US small businesses, including S-corporations. Applications without this will not be considered.



We don’t have anyone on our side who can train you, so you need to know this work well enough to walk in and take over on day one.



You should have:



CPA credential and at least 3 years of bookkeeping and accounting experience

Direct experience preparing US federal and California taxes for S-corporations, including year-end returns, quarterly estimates, and sales and payroll tax filings

Strong QuickBooks Online experience, including setting up a new company file from scratch

Experience cleaning up messy or incomplete books, including categorizing and reconciling a backlog of transactions

Comfort managing two separate companies with separate books and bank accounts

Clear written and spoken English, since you’ll be explaining what you find and what needs to change to someone who isn’t an accountant

An ownership mindset. You spot what’s wrong or missing, tell us, and fix it without waiting to be asked.

Responsibilities

Set up and maintain QuickBooks Online for both entities, including the chart of accounts for the newer company

Record and categorize all income and expenses, and reconcile bank and credit card accounts every month

Clean up historical records for 2024 and 2025 and make sure every expense is properly categorized and deductible where it should be

Prepare and file all taxes for both entities, including year-end S-corp returns, quarterly estimates, and sales and payroll tax filings

Produce simple monthly financials for each location that the owner can actually use

Join a short weekly video call with the owner to walk through progress, open questions, and what’s coming up

Communicate day to day through Google Chat

Schedule



Part-time, around 15–20 hours per week. Expect more hours in the first couple of months while the cleanup is underway, and again during tax season.



Hours are mostly flexible. Some overlap with US Pacific Time is needed for the weekly call and occasional questions, but most of the work can be done on your own schedule.



Start date: As soon as possible



Compensation



$7–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and fit.



How to Apply



Send your resume along with a short note explaining why you would be a good fit for this specific role.



Our Hiring Process

Apply with your resume and a short note.

If your background is a fit, we’ll send you some follow-up questions to answer in writing.

Selected candidates complete a short skills assessment through Google Forms.

Top candidates are invited to a video interview.

title: E-commerce Operations Assistant – Shopify, Customer Support & Fulfilment
description:
We are an Australian e-commerce business selling specialised automotive products to customers worldwide.

We are looking for a reliable, organised and detail-oriented E-commerce Operations Assistant to join us full time.

This is a long-term position. We are not looking for an agency or someone managing many clients at once. We want someone who can learn our business, follow established procedures, take ownership of routine operational tasks and become an important part of our team.



Main Responsibilities



1. Order Processing & Fulfilment

This is one of the most important parts of the role.

You will be responsible for reviewing incoming Shopify orders and making sure each order is correctly processed and fulfilled.

Tasks will include:

- Checking whether the ordered product is currently in stock

- Confirming whether the order has been automatically sent to the correct 3PL or fulfilment warehouse

- Following up with the warehouse if an order has not been processed automatically

- Manually adding orders to a fulfilment spreadsheet when required

- Notifying the warehouse when a manually processed order is ready for fulfilment

- If an item is out of stock, placing a manufacturing order with our supplier and arranging for it to be shipped directly to the customer

- Checking customer shipping details before submitting orders

- Recording fulfilment information accurately

- Monitoring outstanding orders and following up when necessary

- Escalating unusual situations or problems to the business owner



The work is structured and repetitive, and clear instructions will be provided.



2. Customer Support via Help Scout

This is also a very important part of the role.

You will respond to customer
s using Help Scout.

Typical enquiries include:

- Order status and shipping questions

- Product compatibility questions

- General product enquiries

- Returns and warranty questions

- Following up with customers when additional information is required



We will provide product information, procedures and reference material.

More complicated or unusual enquiries can be escalated to the business owner.

Excellent written English is essential. We want someone who can communicate clearly, professionally and naturally with customers.



3. Shopify administration

Shopify administration is an important part of this role. You must be comfortable working directly inside Shopify and making routine changes accurately without step-by-step supervision.

You will:

- Create and update products

- Create and manage product variants

- Update product descriptions, prices and images

- Maintain product data and SKU information

- Update metafields

- Manage collections and product tags

- Update inventory and availability information

- Check that changes appear correctly on the customer-facing website

- Identify missing or inaccurate information

- Follow Shopify procedures and report issues that require developer assistance

Advanced coding, Liquid development and complex theme development are not required. However, you must have genuine hands-on Shopify experience and be capable of managing routine Shopify administration independently.



4. Airtable & Spreadsheet Administration

We use Airtable and spreadsheets to manage parts of our business.

You will help with:

- Data entry

- Updating records

- Adding order, cost and fulfilment information

- Checking information for accuracy

- Identifying missing information

- Keeping records organised and up to date

- Following established workflows



You will not be responsible for designing the Airtable system, building databases or creating complex automations. The system architecture is handled separately.



Required skills and experience

- Excellent written English

- Demonstrated hands-on Shopify administration experience

- Experience with ecommerce operations, order processing or fulfilment

- Experience managing product listings, variants and product data

- Strong attention to detail

- Good spreadsheet skills

- Ability to learn and follow written procedures

- Excellent organisation and time-management skills

- Ability to work independently and use good judgment

- Reliable communication and consistent availability

- Comfortable dealing with customers, suppliers and logistics providers

- Willingness to learn the product catalogue and business processes



Experience with Help Scout, Airtable or similar systems is beneficial.



Working Arrangement

- Full-time position

- 40 hours per week

- Long-term role

- Remote / work from home

- Working directly with the business owner

- Australian e-commerce business

- Customers located worldwide, with most sales coming from English-speaking countries



As you gain experience and become familiar with the business, there will be opportunities to take on additional operational responsibility and help coordinate work with our suppliers, fulfilment partners and specialist contractors.



Salary

Starting salary: US$800 - $1000 per month, negotiable based on experience, skills and overall fit.

Applicants with strong, proven Shopify and ecommerce operations experience may be considered for a higher starting salary.



How to apply

Please include the following in your application:

- Begin your application with the words “Blue Wrench”

- Your expected monthly salary

- Your preferred working hours and timezone

- A brief summary of your Shopify experience

- Examples of Shopify tasks you have personally completed

- Details of any previous ecommerce, fulfilment or customer-support experience

- Confirmation that you are available for a dedicated full-time, long-term position

Start your application with the word PERSIMMON so we know you read the whole listing. Then include:

Your answers to the 3 questions below

Your availability in AEST

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
*** PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT APPLICATION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE PRIOR EXPERIENCE EXCELLING AT THIS ROLE*** 



About Us



At Apartment Lease Finders, we're more than apartment locators. We're problem solvers and advocates. Our mission is simple: help renters across Texas find a place they're proud to call home. Whether someone's relocating across the state or across the country, we make the search process personal, professional, and stress-free.



We've helped thousands of families find their next apartment, and we do it with a system that gets real results — backed by genuine care for every client who trusts us with their search.



God First. People Always.



Learn more at 





Role Overview



This is more than a back-office role, it's a seat at the table as we scale. You'll keep the operational engine running (lease confirmation, invoicing, records accuracy), but just as importantly, you'll help us build the systems, hiring processes, and training infrastructure that let ALF grow into new markets and bring on new team members without losing quality. Sales/Client Success remains the client's single point of contact throughout, so your work is property-, systems-, and team-facing rather than client-facing.



We're looking for someone who's not just organized, but genuinely thinks in systems... someone who sees a repeated problem and wants to fix the process, not just the instance, and who's excited to grow with a mission-focused company as it scales.





Key Responsibilities



Lease & Property Confirmation



-Reach out to properties to confirm lease terms are finalized and accurately reflected in our records

-Verify lease completions and move-in status directly with properties

-Follow up on outstanding invoices/commissions with properties



Hiring & Team Building Support



-Screen resumes and conduct first-round interviews for future hires

-Help coordinate onboarding for new team members — paperwork, system access, and initial training

-Maintain our candidate pipeline/tracker so nothing falls through the cracks



Systems & Process Implementation



-Document and refine SOPs as the company scales (property confirmation process, invoicing workflow, and beyond)

-Help implement new tools and workflow changes across the team — not just use existing ones

-Own and maintain training materials (like our market guides) and keep them current as our processes evolve



Cross-Market Expansion Support



-Help stand up operational processes in new markets as ALF expands, based on what's working in Houston



Reporting & Visibility



-Track and report basic operational KPIs (lease volume, invoice turnaround, move-in confirmation rates) to keep leadership informed without needing to ask





Team



-Join and actively participate in weekly team meetings





What We're Looking For:



-Prior experience in operations, systems/process coordination, or a hybrid admin + hiring support role

-Excellent communication skills — written and verbal

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems, not just checklists

-Comfortable working across tools like Claude, Google Meet, GoHighLevel (GHL), Airtable, and AI-assisted workflows

-Some experience with hiring, screening, or onboarding is a strong plus

****Bonus: experience in real estate, leasing, or property management





Perks:



-Work remotely with a mission-driven, faith-grounded team

-Real opportunity to grow within the company as we expand across Houston, Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio

-Ongoing mentorship and access to resources for skill development



*** PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT RESUME IF YOU DO NOT HAVE PRIOR EXPERIENCE EXCELLING AT THIS ROLE***

title: Construction Sales & Estimating Coordinator
description:
# Construction Sales & Estimating Coordinator – U.S. Construction Company



**About Us**



Cornerstone Crushing is a U.S.-based company specializing in mobile concrete and asphalt crushing, aggregate production, and quarry operations. We provide mobile crushing services throughout the eastern United States and supply construction aggregates from our quarry locations. Our customers include demolition contractors, excavating companies, paving contractors, and other construction businesses..



We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented professional to assist with construction estimating, business development, and sales prospecting.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, researching projects, communicating with customers, and helping grow a business. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of responsibilities, work independently, and proactively identify opportunities.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Construction Estimating & Proposal Preparation**



- Prepare estimates for mobile concrete and asphalt crushing projects using our established Excel pricing templates.

- Review project information, quantities, locations, specifications, and other requirements.

- Calculate project costs using established production rates, equipment costs, mobilization expenses, and other assumptions.

- Prepare professional proposals for management review and approval.

- Manage incoming bid opportunities assigned by management.

- Track bid deadlines, outstanding proposals, and follow-up activities.

- Identify missing information and coordinate with management as needed.



Training will be provided on our crushing operations, estimating methods, and proposal formats.



**2. Business Development & Lead Generation**



- Research upcoming construction, demolition, excavation, and infrastructure projects.

- Search construction bid boards, public project listings, and other online resources.

- Identify contractors and decision-makers who may need mobile crushing services.

- Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers and projects.

- Contact prospective customers through personalized
s and professional phone calls.

- Follow up on opportunities and help generate new business.



**3. Quarry Sales & Marketing**



- Research construction projects and contractors near our quarry locations.

- Identify potential buyers of crushed stone, gravel, recycled aggregate, and other construction materials.

- Contact contractors, estimators, project managers, and purchasing personnel.

- Introduce our products and services and identify potential sales opportunities.

- Assist with preparing material quotations using company-approved pricing.

- Follow up with prospective customers and coordinate qualified opportunities with management.

- Develop relationships with contractors who may become recurring customers.



**4. AI Tools & Process Improvement**



- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve efficiency in research, lead generation, estimating support, and professional communications.

- Leverage AI to identify potential customers, organize project information, and streamline repetitive tasks.

- Independently identify opportunities to improve workflows and productivity.

- Verify AI-generated information for accuracy before using it in estimates, proposals, or customer communications.

- Protect confidential company and customer information when using AI tools.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate naturally and professionally with U.S. contractors.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and comfort working with numbers, formulas, and pricing spreadsheets.

- Experience in construction estimating, B2B sales, business development, or lead generation.

- Proficiency using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity, conduct research, and solve problems.

- Strong internet research skills and ability to identify potential construction projects and customers.

- Comfortable making outbound business calls and communicating directly with potential customers.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and capable of working independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.



**Preferred:**



- Experience working with U.S. construction companies.

- Background in civil engineering, quantity surveying, or construction estimating.

- Experience with excavation, demolition, aggregates, heavy equipment, or construction materials.

- Familiarity with construction bid boards and contractor databases.

- Experience with Microsoft Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.



Prior experience in crushing or quarry operations is not required. Training will be provided.



## What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or performs basic data entry.



We want a proactive individual who enjoys finding opportunities, researching projects, communicating with customers, and completing detailed work accurately.



The ideal candidate is comfortable with both numbers and people. They should be able to prepare estimates carefully while also confidently reaching out to prospective customers.



We value initiative, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and the ability to use technology and AI tools to work efficiently.



## Schedule & Compensation



- Initially approximately 30 hours per week, with the potential to increase to 40 hours.

- Some availability during U.S. Eastern business hours is required for customer calls and communication.

- Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Long-term opportunity with the potential for increased responsibilities.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. A description of your experience working with U.S. construction companies, estimating, or B2B sales.

3. Your experience using Excel for calculations or estimating.

4. A short audio or video introduction (approximately 60–90 seconds) explaining your relevant experience and why you're interested in this position.

5. Your desired hourly rate and availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.



**Please also answer these two questions:**



**Question 1:** If you were asked to find potential customers for a quarry selling crushed stone and gravel in Ohio, as well as contractors who may need mobile concrete and asphalt crushing services throughout the eastern United States, how would you identify potential customers, find project opportunities, and begin contacting them?



**Question 2:** Describe how you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT in your work. Please provide a specific example of how AI has helped you complete a task more efficiently or effectively.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping grow our business.

title: Short-Form Video Creator & Viral Reels Specialist
description:
Instinctive Branding is a 15-year-old US based marketing agency seeking an exceptionally talented creative, results-driven, and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Creator who knows how to turn ideas and raw footage into engaging videos that capture attention, drive engagement and viral works be heat too.



This role is perfect for someone who understands more than just video editing. We’re looking for someone who knows how to create compelling hooks, tell stories through video, follow trends, and develop content that people want to watch, share, and engage with.



If you have created Reels that went viral or generated impressive organic views, we want to see your work!



Key Responsibilities

    •    Create and edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
.

    •    Transform raw footage, interviews, and existing content into compelling short videos.

    •    Develop attention-grabbing hooks that capture viewers within the first 1–3 seconds.

    •    Add captions, transitions, music, sound effects, B-roll, and other creative elements.

    •    Research viral content, trending formats, and relevant audio to generate new ideas.

    •    Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form videos.

    •    Follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across client accounts.

    •    Collaborate with the team to brainstorm content ideas and improve video performance.

    •    Review available analytics and recommend ways to improve engagement and audience retention.

    •    Meet deadlines and manage video projects according to established content calendars and trackers.



Required Skills

    •    Advanced video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar tools.

    •    Proven experience creating Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, or other short-form videos.

    •    Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, captions, and audience retention.

    •    Ability to identify trends and adapt them to different brands and audiences.

    •    Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of visual storytelling.

    •    Ability to follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and feedback.

    •    Comfortable using AI tools to support content research, ideation, scripting, and editing workflows.

    •    Ability to manage tasks independently and consistently meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

    •    Previous experience as a Video Editor, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator.

    •    Experience creating videos that achieved high organic reach or went viral.

    •    Understanding of social media analytics, including views, watch time, shares, saves, and engagement.

    •    Experience editing talking-head videos, interviews, podcasts, educational content, or promotional videos.

    •    Ability to suggest creative concepts, write hooks, and improve existing video ideas.

    •    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who is creative, curious, and proactive. Someone who doesn't simply follow instructions but can also bring fresh ideas to the table.

Our ideal candidate:

    •    Understands what makes people stop scrolling.

    •    Can explain why a video performed well and how to apply those lessons to future content.

    •    Is comfortable experimenting with different hooks, formats, and editing styles.

    •    Takes ownership of their work and pays attention to the little details.

    •    Is organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

    •    Can work independently while collaborating with a creative team.

    •    Focuses on creating effective content, not just making videos look good.



Show Us Your Viral Reels!

This is an important part of your application. Without this, we aren’t interested. 

We want to see what you've actually created and how your videos performed.



Please include:

    •    Links to at least 3–5 Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts you personally created.

    •    Links to at least 2–3 of your best-performing videos, preferably those with high organic views.

    •    The view counts and engagement results for your strongest videos.

    •    A brief explanation of your role in each video, including whether you handled editing, scripting, concept development, filming, or the entire production.

    •    One example of a video you believe performed particularly well and a short explanation of why you think it succeeded.



Please be transparent about your individual contribution, especially if you worked as part of a team. We value genuine experience, creative thinking, and the ability to learn from performance data.



We're not expecting every video to go viral. We're looking for someone who understands what makes content effective and knows how to keep improving it.



Values We Admire

    •    Creativity in approach and problem-solving.

    •    Team players who collaborate well.

    •    Honest and transparent communication.

    •    Kindness and consideration toward others.

    •    Accountability and pride in delivering quality work.

    •    A positive attitude and someone who's fun to work with, even on Zoom!



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

    1    Your resume.

    2    A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

    3    Your portfolio with direct links to your best videos.

    4    Examples of high-performing or viral Reels, including view counts and engagement results.

    5    A brief explanation of what made one of your videos successful.

    6    The editing tools and AI tools you use.



Please change the subject line of your application to: "Look No Further! Great videos here.”

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a brief interview and a small editing test using footage provided by our team.

Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



We're excited to meet you if you’re ready to bring creativity, strong editing skills, and a results-driven mindset to our team!
