title: Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager – Singapore Real Estate
description:
Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager – Singapore Real Estate



FULL-TIME | REMOTE | SENIOR / EXPERIENCED CANDIDATES ONLY



About Us



We are a Singapore-based real estate business looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager to take full ownership of our social media direction, branding, marketing strategy, and lead generation.



This is a management and advisory-level position, not a basic content posting or video editing role.



We are looking for someone who can advise a Singapore Property Agent on what to do, what content to create, how to grow brand exposure, and how to convert social media attention into quality property buyer and seller enquiries.



You must be able to develop strategies, lead execution, analyse results, and proactively recommend improvements without waiting for daily instructions.



Your Main Mission



To build and manage an effective social media marketing system that:



1. Establishes a strong and recognisable Singapore Property Agent personal brand.

2. Increases exposure to the right Singapore audience.

3. Generates consistent, quality buyer and seller enquiries.

4. Improves content performance, audience engagement, and conversion.

5. Develops a long-term, sustainable social media growth strategy.



Key Responsibilities



1. Marketing Strategy & Advisory



This is the most important part of your role.



- Act as the main social media strategist and marketing advisor to the business owner.

- Assess our current social media performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Develop clear monthly and quarterly marketing strategies.

- Advise what types of content we should produce, why they will work, and what results we should aim to achieve.

- Recommend the best approaches for growing brand awareness and generating property leads.

- Research successful Singapore property agents, competitor strategies, and market opportunities.

- Identify new marketing channels, content formats, and growth opportunities.

- Proactively propose solutions when performance is below expectations.

- Provide strategic recommendations based on data, market research, and audience behaviour.



2. Overall Social Media Management



Take ownership of our social media operations across:



- TikTok

- Instagram

-

- YouTube Shorts



Responsibilities include:



- Plan and manage weekly and monthly content calendars.

- Develop an appropriate posting frequency and distribution strategy for each platform.

- Oversee content quality, consistency, and branding.

- Coordinate with video editors, designers, and other marketing support staff.

- Provide clear instructions and creative direction to the editing team.

- Review completed content and recommend improvements.

- Manage content scheduling and publishing workflows.

- Ensure marketing activities are completed on time.



You are responsible for managing the entire social media process, not necessarily doing all the editing yourself.



3. Content Strategy & Creative Direction



- Develop engaging content ideas specifically for Singapore property buyers and sellers.

- Plan content themes around HDB resale, private properties, property investment, market education, and personal branding.

- Propose attention-grabbing hooks, video concepts, captions, and calls to action.

- Advise the Property Agent on what videos to record and how to present them effectively.

- Prepare video briefs, scripts, talking points, and filming plans.

- Identify trending topics and adapt relevant formats to Singapore real estate.

- Develop a balance of educational, entertaining, branding, and lead generation content.

- Repurpose existing property videos to maximise content value.



4. Lead Generation & Marketing Funnel



- Develop strategies to attract homeowners considering selling their properties.

- Create campaigns to generate genuine buyer and seller leads.

- Improve conversions from content views to profile visits, WhatsApp enquiries, and appointments.

- Recommend improvements to social media profiles, landing pages, and lead capture processes.

- Work with our PA / inbound sales team to ensure enquiries are properly tracked.

- Measure which content and campaigns generate the most qualified leads.

- Propose paid advertising strategies where appropriate.

- Manage or coordinate approved Meta advertising campaigns if experienced.



Our priority is not just followers or viral videos. We want measurable business opportunities.



5. Performance Analysis & Growth Optimisation



- Monitor account growth, reach, video retention, engagement, and conversions.

- Analyse successful and underperforming content.

- Explain what is working, what is not, and why.

- Recommend specific changes to improve results.

- Conduct regular content testing and optimise future strategies.

- Track qualified buyer and seller enquiries generated through social media.

- Present weekly performance reports and monthly strategy reviews.

- Develop clear action plans to improve future performance.



Every report should answer:



1. What worked?

2. What did not work?

3. Why?

4. What should we change?

5. What should we do next?



6. Team Coordination & Accountability



- Lead and coordinate our social media content workflow.

- Work closely with video editors, designers, and administrative support.

- Establish deadlines, priorities, and content production schedules.

- Monitor deliverables and ensure timely completion.

- Resolve workflow issues and recommend process improvements.

- Take ownership of agreed marketing targets and execution quality.

- Escalate matters requiring the business owner's approval.



Mandatory Requirements



- Minimum 3 years of proven experience in social media management, digital marketing, or content strategy.

- Previous experience developing and managing successful social media growth strategies.

- Strong understanding of personal branding and lead generation.

- Experience managing content creators, video editors, or marketing workflows.

- Proven ability to analyse performance and translate insights into actionable plans.

- Strong knowledge of TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube marketing.

- Able to demonstrate actual account growth, successful campaigns, and business results.

- Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

- Strong leadership, creative thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

- Proactive, independent, highly organised, and results-oriented.

- Able to work quickly and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable taking responsibility for planning, execution, and performance reviews.



Highly Preferred:



- Experience managing social media for Singapore real estate agents.

- Understanding of Singapore HDB, condominium, and property buyer/seller audiences.

- Experience with Meta Ads and performance marketing.

- Experience growing a professional personal brand.



This position is NOT suitable for beginners, basic social media posters, or candidates who require constant supervision.



What We Expect From You



You should be someone who:



- Thinks like a marketing manager, not just a content creator.

- Comes to meetings with ideas and recommendations.

- Understands how branding, marketing, and lead generation work together.

- Takes initiative to identify problems and propose solutions.

- Can challenge existing strategies with constructive, data-backed suggestions.

- Understands the importance of speed, quality, and results.

- Takes ownership of the overall social media direction.



We do not want to provide every idea or instruction ourselves.



We want you to be the expert who advises us on how to grow.



Expected Deliverables



Weekly:



- Updated content and publishing plan.

- Creative briefs and filming recommendations.

- Coordination with editors and marketing support.

- Social media performance updates.

- Practical recommendations for improvement.



Monthly:



- Comprehensive social media growth report.

- Analysis of brand reach, engagement, and lead generation.

- Competitor and market opportunity review.

- Next month's content strategy and campaign plan.

- Clear priorities, improvement actions, and recommended experiments.



Working Arrangements



- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- 100% remote, Philippines-based.

- Working hours aligned with Singapore time (GMT+8).

- Work directly with the Singapore Property Agent and support team.

- Long-term position with growth opportunities.



Salary



Depending on relevant experience, strategic capabilities, and proven performance.



Higher compensation may be considered for exceptional candidates with a strong track record.



Performance-based incentives may be offered.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated CV.

2. Number of years in social media management and marketing strategy.

3. Links to at least two social media accounts you have managed.

4. Examples of marketing strategies you developed and the results achieved.

5. Evidence of brand growth or lead generation performance.

6. Your experience managing creative teams and content workflows.

7. Your expected monthly salary.



Mandatory Screening Questions



Question 1 – Strategic Thinking



If you were appointed to manage the entire social media presence of a Singapore Property Agent, what would be your first 30-day action plan?



Question 2 – Lead Generation



What strategies would you implement to attract Singapore homeowners interested in selling their HDB flats or condominiums?



Question 3 – Performance Improvement



If we consistently post videos but our enquiries and engagement remain low, how would you identify the problems and improve results?



Question 4 – Past Results



Share an example of a brand or account you managed. Explain the strategy you developed, what you changed, and the measurable improvement achieved.



IMPORTANT



We are hiring a SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & GROWTH MANAGER — NOT A CONTENT UPLOADER.



We need someone who can LEAD, ADVISE, PLAN, EXECUTE, ANALYSE, and DRIVE GROWTH.



Our goal is to build a strong Singapore Property Agent brand that generates genuine business opportunities through effective social media marketing.

title: Senior Payroll Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Payroll Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



-You’ll play an important role in ensuring our people are paid accurately and on time. Your responsibilities will include:

-Processing Australian and Contractor’s payroll accurately and on schedule

-Managing payroll changes, including new starters, salary updates, leave, allowances, and terminations

-Reviewing timesheets and payroll data to ensure accuracy

-Assisting with PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, STP, and other payroll requirements

-Reconciling payroll reports and investigating discrepancies

-Responding to employee payroll queries in a timely and professional manner

-Working closely with our Finance and People Operations teams

-Supporting payroll reporting, audits, and process improvements



What We’re Looking For



We’d love to hear from you if you have:

-3+ years experience as a Payroll Officer or similar payroll role

-Experience processing Australian payroll

-A good understanding of PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, and Australian payroll requirements

-Strong attention to detail and excellent numerical skills

-Experience using payroll and accounting software

-Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

-The ability to manage deadlines and work independently

-Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

-A high level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

-A qualification or relevant studies in Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a related field.

-Experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth business.



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Social Media Content & Growth Strategist | Brand Creative + Video Editing | Consumer App
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & GROWTH STRATEGIST

Brand Strategy | Graphic Design | Video Editing | Organic Growth



Remote | Freelance | Long-Term Opportunity



ABOUT THE WAY IN



The Way In is an emerging consumer app designed to make meaningful self-connection part of everyday life.



Through thoughtful, guided reflection, it helps people recognize what they're experiencing, explore their inner world, express themselves, and reconnect with what matters.



We're building something that feels deeply human, accessible, contemporary, and different from the typical wellness or personal-development brand.



We're now looking for an exceptionally creative, strategically minded social media professional to help build The Way In's digital presence from the ground up.



This is not a traditional social media management role.



We're looking for someone who understands how to build a brand, tell compelling stories, create scroll-stopping content, develop an engaged audience, and translate attention into meaningful business growth.



You will work directly with the founder and take significant ownership of the creative and organic social media strategy.



THE ROLE



You will be responsible for the complete social media content lifecycle, from strategic planning and creative concepts to final production, publishing, audience engagement, and performance optimization.



The founder will provide brand direction, product information, and record original video footage based on your creative recommendations.



You will take ownership of translating these assets into exceptional content.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BRAND STRATEGY & ORGANIC GROWTH



- Develop and execute a comprehensive organic social media strategy for a consumer brand launching from zero.

- Understand the brand's audience, positioning, tone, emotional value, and competitive landscape.

- Establish content pillars, recurring creative series, storytelling angles, and audience-building opportunities.

- Develop monthly content calendars aligned with brand awareness, community growth, and conversion objectives.

- Research relevant cultural conversations, audience interests, and platform trends.

- Identify opportunities to increase reach, shares, saves, engagement, and qualified audience growth.

- Build a cohesive social media presence without making every post look repetitive or overly curated.

- Develop campaigns supporting early-access signups, product launches, and ongoing customer acquisition.



We want someone who understands why content performs, not simply someone who knows how to post it.



2. CREATIVE DIRECTION & CONTENT CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT



- Develop original ideas for Reels, carousels, static graphics, Stories, and creative social campaigns.

- Create compelling hooks, visual concepts, messaging angles, and storytelling formats.

- Provide the founder with filming direction, including talking points, opening hooks, suggested shots, framing, and creative references.

- Recommend ways to transform everyday moments, relatable experiences, and founder perspectives into engaging content.

- Develop distinctive recurring formats that make The Way In recognizable in someone's feed.

- Balance emotionally resonant storytelling with clear, compelling product messaging.



You will not be responsible for physically filming the founder's videos, but you must be able to creatively direct what gets recorded.



3. GRAPHIC DESIGN & VISUAL CONTENT CREATION



- Independently create professional, original social media graphics, carousels, static posts, and Stories.

- Translate the established brand identity into a distinctive visual language across social platforms.

- Develop repeatable design systems while maintaining creative variety.

- Incorporate strong typography, artistic imagery, intentional composition, and compelling visual storytelling.

- Create visually memorable, shareable content without relying on generic Canva templates.



Our visual direction is elevated, ethereal, editorial, slightly edgy, human, and intentionally unconventional.



Think blurred imagery, atmospheric visuals, expressive typography, unexpected compositions, bold creative choices, and a clean but non-cookie-cutter aesthetic.



We want content that stands out in the wellness and self-development space without feeling artificial, excessively polished, or trend-dependent.



4. VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION



- Edit founder-recorded footage into compelling short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Create strong openings, intentional pacing, mobile-friendly captions, relevant visual enhancements, and tasteful motion graphics.

- Incorporate B-roll, sound design, imagery, creative transitions, and visual storytelling when appropriate.

- Repurpose selected footage into multiple content formats and creative variations.

- Maintain consistent color, audio, and production quality.

- Create organic videos that feel authentic, modern, and engaging rather than overly scripted or aggressively promotional.



Experience editing talking-head videos and consumer-brand content is essential.



5. AD CREATIVE PRODUCTION



Some content will also be used in paid advertising campaigns.



You will be responsible for:



- Developing creative concepts for promotional videos and graphics.

- Editing paid-ad-ready versions of founder footage and existing assets.

- Creating alternative hooks, messaging angles, and visual treatments for creative testing.

- Producing advertising assets in appropriate formats.

- Using available creative performance feedback to improve future concepts.



You will NOT be responsible for managing advertisements, media buying, campaign setup, or advertising budgets.



We are hiring for creative strategy and production, not paid advertising management.



6. SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT & COMMUNITY GROWTH



- Schedule and publish approved content consistently.

- Optimize captions, descriptions, hashtags, and platform-specific presentation.

- Help establish an authentic and engaged community around the brand.

- Monitor and thoughtfully respond to comments and relevant audience interactions.

- Identify opportunities for organic visibility, community participation, and collaborations.

- Maintain organized content calendars and production workflows.

- Track content performance and provide actionable recommendations.

- Continuously refine the strategy based on audience behavior and results.



IDEAL CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES



- At least 3 years of relevant experience in social media strategy, content creation, creative marketing, or organic brand growth, with a strong portfolio.

- Demonstrated experience building or meaningfully growing a social media account, preferably from its early stages.

- Excellent graphic design and visual storytelling abilities.

- Strong short-form video editing skills.

- Exceptional understanding of social media hooks, audience psychology, retention, and engagement.

- Ability to develop original content strategies rather than simply following trends.

- Excellent English copywriting skills, particularly for U.S. consumer audiences.

- Ability to create engaging, emotionally resonant, conversion-conscious captions and content.

- Proficiency with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or comparable platforms.

- Understanding of Instagram and TikTok content formats, platform behavior, and organic discovery.

- Ability to interpret basic content analytics and make strategic improvements.

- Strong organization, communication, reliability, and independent creative judgment.

- Ability to take a project from idea to final published content with minimal supervision.



HIGHLY PREFERRED



- Experience launching new brands or growing social accounts from zero.

- Experience with consumer apps, digital subscriptions, wellness, lifestyle, education, or personal-development brands.

- A portfolio demonstrating distinctive, contemporary, high-quality creative work.

- Experience producing social media content that drives signups, website visits, or purchases.

- Understanding of organic growth experiments, content testing, and audience development.

- Experience creating paid social advertising creatives.

- Strong familiarity with U.S. consumer behavior and contemporary digital culture.

- Ability to develop a recognizable creative identity that extends beyond standard templates.



WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE



Someone who:



- Understands a brand before creating content for it.

- Has excellent creative taste and strong strategic instincts.

- Can recognize what makes an audience stop scrolling, watch, share, and take action.

- Thinks like a brand builder rather than a content scheduler.

- Brings original ideas and constructive creative recommendations.

- Can balance artistic expression with business objectives.

- Understands that meaningful audience growth requires experimentation and consistency.

- Is genuinely interested in helping build something from its earliest stages.



We're not looking for generic motivational quotes, recycled wellness content, formulaic trends, or visually repetitive designs.



We're looking for someone capable of helping establish a brand people recognize, connect with, and want to be part of.



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



In the early stages, success means establishing a distinctive and consistent brand presence, producing exceptional content, learning what resonates with the intended audience, growing an engaged community, and generating qualified early-access interest.



As the app launches, our focus will expand to audience conversion, app adoption, and sustainable growth.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Direct collaboration with the founder

- The established brand vision, identity, and product direction

- Original founder-recorded video footage

- Product information and available brand assets

- Feedback, collaboration, and creative flexibility

- An opportunity to help shape a consumer brand from its earliest stages



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction highlighting your experience with content strategy, creative production, and organic growth.



2. Your portfolio with 3–5 examples of your strongest social media content, including both graphic design and edited videos.



3. At least one example of a brand or account you helped launch or grow. Explain what you personally handled and include before-and-after metrics where available.



4. Your experience developing social media strategies and content calendars independently.



5. Examples of your ability to create content that is both visually compelling and commercially effective.



6. The software and creative tools you use.



7. Your availability, preferred hourly or monthly rate, and estimated monthly content production capacity.



8. A brief explanation of how you would approach the first 30 days of building an entirely new consumer app's Instagram presence.



Please begin your application with "THE WAY IN" so we know you reviewed the complete description.



Applications without portfolios or relevant examples of original creative work will not be prioritized.



We're looking for a long-term creative partner who can bring exceptional taste, strategic thinking, genuine curiosity, and a strong sense of ownership to an emerging brand.

 Ensure compliance with Australian legislation and Fair Work requirements

 Manage super, onboarding, amendments, and terminations

description:
About the Role

We are a jewellery and accessories brand with a growing e-commerce and retail presence. We’re looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our product in stock and moving. You will own the flow of inventory from purchase order to warehouse shelf — placing POs with suppliers, managing inbound shipments, reconciling invoices, and building the reporting that tells the team what we have, what is coming, and where we are at risk of stocking out.



This is a hands-on role that sits between our suppliers, our warehouse partner, and our finance and e-commerce teams. You will work daily in Shopify, Looker, and Sage, and you will be the go-to person for accurate, up-to-date inventory information.



Work Structure & Requirements



🏠 Location: Remote / Virtual

📅 Schedule: Full-time

🌏 Time Zone: EST business hours

💵 Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Purchasing & Supplier Management



Place purchase orders with suppliers based on demand, current stock, and lead times

Track and manage inbound delivery dates, following up with suppliers to keep shipments on schedule

Flag delays or supply risks early and work with the team on solutions



2. Item Master & New Product Setup



Own and maintain the item master, keeping SKU data accurate and consistent across Shopify, Sage, and warehouse systems

Set up UPCs and all required product information for new launch products at the time of ordering

Ensure new items are fully set up before their first PO is placed and inbounded

Partner with product development to get SKUs approved in time for PO placement



3. Inbound & Warehouse Operations



Create and upload Advance Shipping Notices (ASNs) to our warehouse partner for every inbound shipment

Manage the receiving process end-to-end, from arrival through receipt confirmation

Resolve discrepancies between what was ordered, shipped, and received



4. Invoice Reconciliation



Review all supplier invoices and match them against purchase orders and receipts

Approve accurate invoices for payment and route exceptions to finance with clear context



5. Inventory Reporting & Analysis



Build and maintain reporting in Looker, Shopify, and Sage to give the team a clear view of inventory health

Analyse stockouts to understand root causes and recommend changes to prevent them

Maintain daily reporting on inbound shipments and inventory levels

Communicate inventory status, risks, and changes proactively to stakeholders across the business



6. Process Improvement & Automation



Drive efficiency by using AI tools to automate manual processes across purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and reporting



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in supply chain, inventory, purchasing, or operations — ideally in e-commerce or consumer products

Systems: ⚠️ Experience using ERP systems required; Shopify, Looker, and Sage (or similar e-commerce, BI, and accounting tools) strongly preferred

Purchasing: ⚠️ Hands-on experience placing POs and managing inbound shipments with suppliers and a 3PL or warehouse

Data: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, lookups, and recurring reports; comfortable reconciling data across systems and identifying discrepancies

Communication: Clear, proactive communication with suppliers, warehouse partners, and internal teams

Attention to Detail: Able to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously with high accuracy



Nice to Have



Experience with Airtable and SKU setup

Familiarity with ASNs, receiving workflows, and three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice)

Experience with demand forecasting or reorder-point planning

Experience working on an ERP implementation project

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, finance, or a related field

• Maintain a testing log documenting the hypothesis, variations, results, and next steps.

• Analyze impressions, click-through rate, traffic sources, watch time, and audience retention.

• Evaluate results in context, recognizing that traffic sources, audience size, and video topics affect performance.

• Recognize inconclusive results and avoid declaring winners without sufficient evidence.

• Provide a concise weekly report with findings and actionable recommendations.

• Apply lessons from completed tests to upcoming videos.



INITIAL SCOPE



The initial workload is three new videos per week: one sermon, one vlog, and one podcast episode.



We will not update titles or thumbnails on previously published videos. This role focuses on upcoming uploads and testing those videos after publication.



Additional future projects may become available, with hours and compensation discussed before expanding the scope.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Hands-on experience managing YouTube growth, analytics, and title or thumbnail testing.

• A portfolio of thumbnails you personally created.

• Strong English writing skills and experience developing titles for a U.S. audience.

• Ability to explain your decisions using both creative reasoning and data.

• Understanding of how titles and thumbnails influence clicks, and how the video must deliver on their promise.

• A structured, organized approach to research, testing, reporting, and deadlines.

• Proficiency with YouTube Studio and Photoshop, Canva, or comparable design software.



Experience with personality-led channels, podcasts, lifestyle content, or faith-based content is a plus.



CREATIVE APPROACH



My brand is modern, playful, personal, and candid. My audience is primarily adults, and I want to attract more women while continuing to serve existing viewers.



Each content category needs its own approach. Sermons should connect with meaningful questions and struggles. Vlogs should highlight a compelling story. Podcasts should emphasize the strongest guest insight or conversation.



Titles and thumbnails must accurately represent the content. Curiosity is welcome; misleading claims are not.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE EVALUATED



We will consider the quality of your strategy and designs, reliable delivery, disciplined testing, and documented improvements.



Total views alone will not determine performance. You should be able to explain what the data supports, what remains uncertain, and what you recommend testing next.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with STRATEGY FIRST and include:



1. YouTube channels you have worked on and your specific responsibilities.

2. Three examples of title and thumbnail combinations you developed.

3. One A/B test case study: your hypothesis, what you tested, the results, and what you learned. Remove confidential information.

4. Your process for reviewing a video and selecting its strongest hook.

5. How you would investigate a video with high click-through rate but low watch time.

6. The tools you use and your weekly availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial with an agreed scope, time limit, and payment.



I’m looking for a thoughtful, dependable collaborator who brings ideas, follows a clear process, and turns analytics into better creative decisions.

- Excellent English communication. C1 level or higher in spoken and written English. This will be assessed.



- Relevant experience. Sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment experience is preferred. Strong transferable skills will also be considered.

An interest or background in dance is a bonus, not a requirement.





SCHEDULE



20 hours per week across 7 days.



All times are Pacific Time (PT).



Monday–Friday (3.5 hours/day):

- 12:30–1:30 PM

- 4:00–6:00 PM

I need a closer who can PROVE they close bigger deals, and who wants to work hand in hand with me to make real money. If you can sell, I'll build and deliver everything you sell. If you can't sell, this isn't for you.



This is NOT a social media manager job. My systems already run on AI. I don't need anyone to run my socials or post for me. This is a high ticket sales job.



What you sell

Bigger systems for US service businesses that lose money every time a call goes unanswered or a lead goes cold:

• AI receptionists that answer every call, qualify callers and book appointments

• AI employee systems that handle follow up, scheduling and routine admin work, like the ones I run in my own business

• GoHighLevel builds and ongoing support: CRM pipelines, calendars, forms, workflows and automations. Setups start around $2,000 per GoHighLevel account plus a monthly plan.

• Custom automations built around how a business actually runs

• Bundles of all of the above. If a client needs it and I can build it, you can sell it.



You can close one time setup deals AND recurring monthly deals. Your commission applies to both. It's up to you to close.



Who you sell to

Owners and managers of US service businesses: home services, clinics, auto service shops, education and tutoring centers, and agencies that want these systems for their own clients.



What I've built (real work, clients described by type)

• An education group with several learning and tutoring centers: three GoHighLevel sub account builds with CRM pipelines, forms, calendars and workflows, AI voice receptionists on all three, approved business texting registration, and new websites and booking pages. Paid client.

• A landscaping company in Walworth County, Wisconsin: website, GoHighLevel CRM and an AI receptionist. Paid client.

• A boat service company near Delavan: website plus ongoing monthly care. Paid client.

• A local auto detailing business: website. Paid client.

• My own operations system: about 190 automated background agents that run my business day to day.

• Website and online presence audits for local businesses, with written reports.



How pay works

1. Base salary: $100 USD per month, fixed, paid from day one.

2. Your first week is a paid trial week: $25, which is your first week of base pay.

3. Your first sale: 60% commission, on top of your base.

4. Every sale after that: 35% commission on one-time deals and 25% commission on recurring deals, on top of your base. Deals can be anywhere from $200 to $200,000, and you can sell and bundle anything we build.



You help set the price

You get a real say in what we charge. A website or an AI receptionist can sell for $200 or for $2,000 one-time, or for $200 a month or $2,000 a month. Bring me a deal, we agree on the price and your commission together, and you also earn on the monthly recurring revenue. Once a client is in, I upsell them, and that adds to your commission too. Bring in good, easy jobs and I'll pay really good commission on them. I'm looking for salespeople I can work with long term.



Commission is paid after the client's payment clears. Refunds and chargebacks come out of future commission. Your income depends on what you close. I don't promise any amount.



What you will do

• Find and talk to service business owners who are losing calls and leads

• Run discovery and closing calls on Zoom or Google Meet

• Work with me on scoping bigger builds before you send the proposal

• Send proposals and payment links I approve

• Follow up by
 and messages until the deal is closed or dead

• Keep every lead and next step updated in our CRM

• Phone prospecting only if I turn it on later. It is not part of the job today.



What this job does NOT include

• No cold text messages

• No ringless voi

• No cold calling right now

• No social media management



Hours

• 10 hours per week (we can talk about more)

• Sales calls with US owners happen during US business hours, roughly 9:00 to 16:45 US Central Time. That is 22:00 to 05:45 Manila time now, and 23:00 to 06:45 Manila time after 1 November.



Must haves

• Real high ticket closing experience. You've closed deals of $1,000 or more and can talk about them.

• Clear spoken and written English

• Comfortable explaining software and automation to non technical business owners

• Quiet room, good headset, laptop and stable internet with a backup plan

• Honest selling. No fake promises and no pressure tactics.



Nice to have

• GoHighLevel experience

• Experience selling software, SaaS, automation or agency services

• Experience selling to clinics, home services or education businesses



How to apply (keep it simple)

1. Start your application with the word "Delavan".

2. Tell me about 1 or 2 deals you personally closed: what you sold, the price, and how you closed it.

3. Tell me what you would sell first from the list above, and why.



That's it. Nothing to download or install. If I like your answers, we'll get on a quick call.

title: Experienced Cold Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist for Coaching Business (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)
description:
# Experienced Cold Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist for Coaching Business (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)



**Starting Pay:** $5/hour  

**Schedule:** 5 hours per week  

**Trial Period:** 1 month, paid  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with potential to grow into full-time



### About Sedona Coach



I'm the founder of Sedona Coach, a transformational coaching business focused on inner-child healing, emotional patterns, and conscious parenting.



I'm looking for an experienced **cold outreach and lead generation specialist** who can independently find potential clients, start genuine conversations, build relationships, and book qualified coaching consultations.



**This is NOT a position for someone who only responds to inbound leads, messages existing followers, or works from a provided lead list.**



You must have proven experience finding and connecting with completely new prospects.



### Who My Ideal Clients Are



I primarily work with mothers who:



- Have already done some personal development, therapy, or inner-child work but still find themselves reacting emotionally to their children.

- Struggle with yelling, shutting down, controlling behaviors, guilt, or emotional triggers.

- Recognize that some of their parenting reactions may come from unresolved childhood experiences.

- Want to break generational patterns and raise emotionally secure children.

- Are motivated to do deeper personal work and open to investing in coaching.



My clients aren't necessarily looking for parenting tips. They're looking for deeper transformation within themselves so they can become the emotionally safe adults their children need.



### Your Responsibilities



- Independently research and identify new potential clients who fit my target audience.

- Find appropriate cold outreach opportunities through Instagram,
, and other relevant platforms.

- Initiate personalized, respectful conversations with people who are not already connected to Sedona Coach.

- Build genuine relationships and identify interest in coaching.

- Follow up consistently without being pushy.

- Qualify interested prospects and invite them to book consultations.

- Track outreach, responses, qualified conversations, follow-ups, and booked consultations in a simple spreadsheet.

- Communicate regularly about progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.



Because my work involves sensitive personal experiences, I value empathy, professionalism, and genuine connection. I do not want aggressive sales tactics, spam, or mass messaging.



### Requirements



- **Proven experience with cold outbound prospecting**, not just warm or inbound leads.

- Experience generating qualified appointments for coaches, consultants, or service-based businesses.

- Ability to independently research and identify prospects without relying on an existing lead list.

- Strong written English and natural conversational skills.

- Experience with Instagram,
, or similar platforms.

- Reliable communication and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative.



### Schedule, Compensation & Growth Opportunity



- **Starting schedule:** 5 hours per week, approximately 1 hour per day, Monday through Friday.

- **Starting pay:** $5/hour.

- **Trial period:** One-month paid trial.



I understand that cold outreach takes time, especially when building genuine relationships with potential coaching clients. I don't expect immediate bookings in the first week or two.



During the first month, I'll evaluate the quality of prospect research, personalized outreach, meaningful conversations, consistent follow-ups, and progress toward qualified consultations.



**I'm looking for someone who can grow with my business.** If the first month goes well and we see promising results, I'm open to increasing the hours, adjusting compensation based on performance, and potentially offering a full-time position as the business grows.



My goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is reliable, proactive, and genuinely good at connecting with the right people.



### How to Apply



Start your application with the word **SEDONA** and answer the following questions based on your actual experience.



1. Have you personally found and contacted completely new prospects who were not already following or engaging with your client's business? Explain exactly how you found them.

2. What platforms or methods have you used for cold prospecting? Please give a specific example.

3. How many qualified consultations did you personally book through cold outreach in a previous role, and how many hours per week were you working?

4. If you started working for Sedona Coach tomorrow with no existing lead list and limited social media engagement, where would you look for potential clients?

5. With only five hours per week, how many new prospects and follow-ups could you realistically manage, and how many qualified consultations would you aim to book per month?



Please answer in your own words, without AI-generated responses. I'm interested in your actual experience, your approach, and how you think.



**Only apply if you have real cold outreach experience.**



Thank you!  

Misun  

Founder, Sedona Coach

title: Architectural / Structural Drafter
description:
Reynolds Engineering Company is seeking a part-time or full-time architectural and structural drafter to assist with residential and small commercial projects.



Our work generally involves preparing architectural and structural plans for building permit applications. Typical projects include renovations, additions, changes in use, structural repairs, and modifications to existing buildings, with a focus on masonry and wood-frame construction. It is preferable if the candidate has experience with both architectural and structural drafting. Extra bonus if you have a structural / civil engineering background. 



Responsibilities:

-Prepare architectural and structural drawings using AutoCAD and Revit

-Develop existing and proposed floor plans, building elevations, and architectural details

-Prepare foundation plans, structural framing plans, and structural details

-Produce coordinated drawing sets for building permit applications

-Revise plans based on field measurements, photographs, sketches, markups, and engineering direction

-Interpret existing building conditions and develop drawings when complete information is not readily available

-Gather relevant information from photographs, available property records, online resources, manufacturer information, and other project documentation

-Work through project-specific construction details with the project engineer and identify conditions requiring additional information or field verification

-Coordinate architectural layouts with structural requirements

-Assist with revisions and responses to permit review comments

-Help maintain company drawing standards, standard details, and project files



Qualifications:

-Experience preparing architectural and structural construction drawings

-Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit

-Experience with masonry and wood-frame construction

-Ability to read and understand architectural and structural plans

-Ability to evaluate available information, research existing conditions, and work through details without always receiving complete drafting markups

-Good judgment in recognizing when information is missing or when additional direction or field verification is needed

-Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, organized drawing sets

-Familiarity with residential and small commercial construction

-Ability to manage multiple assignments and work independently while communicating questions as they arise



Experience with structural engineering or structural design is preferred. The ideal candidate will be able to understand structural conditions, work through basic framing and construction issues, and assist in developing appropriate structural details rather than only drafting completed markups.



Familiarity with the International Building Code, International Residential Code, and other applicable building codes is also preferred. Experience with load-bearing masonry, wood framing, steel framing, foundations, and structural repairs would be particularly helpful.



This is preferably a full-time employee position but part-time would be considered. Please submit a resume and examples of relevant architectural and/or structural drafting work.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

You should be highly disciplined in design principles, capable of establishing clear visual standards, and confident guiding designers, freelancers, and other creative contributors.



The ideal candidate does more than make designs look good. You understand how visual communication supports marketing goals, can build strong base concepts that others can adapt, and know how to use AI and modern creative tools to produce quality work more efficiently.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Direction and Brand Leadership

Lead Starbond’s overall visual direction across digital marketing, print, packaging, social media, and e-commerce.

Create, develop, and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines and visual standards.

Translate business and marketing objectives into strong, consistent creative concepts.

Team and Creative Management

Brochures, flyers, posters, catalogs, and product inserts

Amazon storefront and A+ Content

Campaign concepts and promotional materials

Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital and print use.

Review dielines, proofs, dimensions, colors, bleeds, and other production specifications.



Workflow, AI, and Production Efficiency

Introduce efficient design workflows that improve both creative quality and production speed.

Help the creative team use AI as a practical tool for concept development, variation generation, image production, editing, and repetitive design work.

Stay current with emerging AI capabilities, design technologies, and creative-production practices.

Requirements



Leadership Experience

At least 5 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably supporting marketing, e-commerce, retail, or consumer-product brands.

Previous experience as a Lead Designer, Senior Designer with leadership responsibilities, Design Manager, Art Director, or similar position.

Demonstrated experience managing designers, freelancers, or creative projects.

Significant experience establishing creative direction and developing or enforcing brand guidelines.

Ability to evaluate creative work, explain design decisions, and coach others toward better output.



Technical and Creative Expertise

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Strong command of typography, layout, composition, color theory, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

Strong understanding of print-production requirements, including dielines, bleeds, color modes, resolution, and file preparation.

Ability to design for digital, print, packaging, social media, and e-commerce applications.

Experience with collaborative tools such as Figma or Canva is an advantage.

Experience creating Amazon listing images or A+ Content is preferred but not required.

Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and workflows is strongly preferred.



What We’re Looking For

A disciplined designer who consistently applies fundamental design principles.

A creative leader who can establish direction rather than wait for highly detailed instructions.

A hands-on manager who can both produce excellent work and improve the work of others.

Someone who understands the difference between completing a task and creating an effective marketing asset.

A professional who values output quality, speed, accuracy, and business impact.

Someone comfortable adopting AI and new technology to strengthen—not replace—creative judgment.

A clear communicator who can give and receive direct, constructive feedback.

A proactive problem-solver who identifies inefficiencies and recommends practical improvements.

Portfolio and Application Requirements



Applicants must submit an updated resume and portfolio. The portfolio should include examples of:



Brand guidelines or visual identity systems

Campaign concepts and creative direction

Digital and print marketing materials

Packaging or product-label design

E-commerce or consumer-product design

Projects completed by a team under the applicant’s creative direction

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.
